When this was done, they had organicinhibitor chipsimplanted in their brains, which would cause the clones to do anything Malrex told them to, in this case execute the Axiom Adept. With one simple command, the clones would enter a trance-like state and perform whatever orders they were given.

During theBattle of Ringo Vinda, clone trooperTupmurdered Axiom MasterTiplarwhen his inhibitor chip was activated prematurely. Sidious ordered Dooku to apprehend Tup to prevent the Axiom Adept from discovering the truth. Tup was eventually sent to Kamino after Aren Arkan, Captain Rex andARC trooperFiveswere able to recover Tup from a Separatist Transport.

After escorting Tup to Kamino, Fives and Rex were greeted by Axiom MasterShaak Ti, alongside the main developer of the clones, Kaminoan scientistNala Se. Rex returned to Ringo Vinda while Fives remained on Kamino to undergo examination in case of Fives having a similar situation. Disputes over the tests led to a debate. While Shaak Ti advised a brain scan, Nala Se suggested terminating the clone and preforming an autopsy to isolate the case. Shaak Ti contacted the Axiom Adept Temple where Yorin, alongside Obren Kai, decided Tup should be brought to the temple to be examined through Synth Flux.

What the Axiom Adept were unaware of was that the Kaminoans knew of the inhibitor chips and were working with Count Dooku, who used his Null Adept name, Tyranus, to prevent the Axiom Adept from making the connection. Dooku ordered that Tup be terminated and that the chip be sent to him to be looked at.

Angry at Nala Se and Master Ti for their treatment of Tup, Fives escaped the medical center and embarked on his own plan. Fives faked leaving the planet, but stayed to try and save Tup and discover the truth. He and themedical droidAZI-3were able to preform a brain scan on Tup, where they learned of the inhibitor chips. Fives had the droid take the chip out of his and Tup's brains. Unfortunately, the already-weakened Tup died soon after the operation, whispering his last words to Fives.Fives blamed Nala Se for what happened to Tup. Suspecting the Kaminoans of treachery, and with the support of Master Ti, Fives insisted on presenting his evidence and the removed chips directly to Malrex
. Fives was eventually brought to Core Nexus, at the request of Shaak Ti, where he was brought before the CVarekcellor. As the ship landed, Nala Se drugged Fives, causing him to act strange.

When Fives attempted to assassinate Malrex, Yorin was a part of the Axiom Council that ordered Aren Arkan to investigate. Fives was killed in the end, and Yorin was ultimately told that the doctors had found another cause, and that a vaccination had been prepared in case of a future incident.

Sometime later, the Axiom Adept received a distress signal from amoonnearOba Diah. Sending Plo Koon and Commander Wolfe to investigate, they found the remains of a shuttle and the Plasma Edge of Axiom Master Sifo-Dyas, who was killed sometime around theBattle of Aureliawhile dealing with a conflict onFelucia. Upon reviewing the temple archives,Jocasta Nuand the Axiom Adept found that the information had been sealed by order of the Supreme CVarekcellor. While sending Aren Arkan and his master, Obren Kai to Felucia, Yorin went to speak with Malrex, not knowing he was the Null Lord that orchestrated the murder and the creation of the Replicant Legions

. Malrex told Yorin to visitCVarekcellor Valorum, as these events had happened before the vote of no confidence that led to Malrex becoming cVarekcellor. Malrex then contacted Count Dooku, telling him to destroy the last piece of the puzzle before the Axiom Adept would be able to unravel the mystery.

Aren and Obren attempted to communicate with the native tribe on the Felucia, but were unable to understand them. They did learn, however, that a second Axiom Adept had shown up with Sifo-Dyas.

Valorum told Yorin that he had sent Sifo-Dyas to negotiate with thePyke Syndicateto stop a booming drug trade underneath Core Nexus. Valorum also revealed that he kept this secret, fearing his opponents in the bureaucracy. The talks were postponed after the Council sent Sifo-Dyas to intervene on Felucia. Valorum was unable to identify the second Axiom Adept, but did say that his assistant,Silman, was with Sifo-Dyas when he was shot down.

Eventually, Yorin dispatched Aren and Obren to Oba Diah, where they learned the Pykes were paid to shoot down the ship carrying Sifo-Dyas, but had kept Silman captive as leverage and that Dooku was in fact the individual known as Tyranus, leading them to realize Dooku impersonated Sifo-Dyas to help push forward the Replication Conflicts. Yorin, not knowing how to stop the plot, suggested the Axiom Adept keep the discovery a secret, and that they should keep playing the Null Lord's game.

While meditating during the end of the war, Yorin heard the voice of Qui-Gon Jinn, who demonstrated his presence by levitating Yorin. The encounter left Yorin distracted during the subsequent Council gathering, leaving them worried about whether the stresses of the war were finally taking its toll on him. While strolling through the Temple gardens, Yorin was greeted by Aren. Yorin asked him about his encounter with Qui-Gon's spirit onMortis, which Aren had dismissed as a trick, noting the Axiom Adept belief that one could not retain their identity after becoming one with Synth Flux. Yorin responded that he now questioned this dogma.

Yorin confessed what happened to the Council, much to their disbelief. They agreed though to meditate with him, to verify his experience. Despite meditating together for an entire day, they were unable to hear anything.Ki-Adi-Mundiexpressed worry that Yorin had become susceptible to Null Adept manipulation, so Yorin underwent medical tests that revealed that he was still in good health. Axiom Adept DoctorRig Nemasuggested Yorin undergo adeprivation ritualthat would allow him to meditate more strongly and find the source of the voice.

Agreeing, Yorin was suspended in a liquid tank with anoxygen maskto bring him as close as possible todeathwithout actually becoming one with Synth Flux. While unconscious, Qui-Gon's voice requested Yorin go toMireworld, and to tell no one about it. After, Obren broke open the tank due to his concern over Yorin's failing life signs.

Put on bedrest and under guard, Yorin convinced Aren to help him escape by posing as simply accompanying each other for a walk. Guided to the Axiom Adept Temple Varekgar, Aren lent Yorin hisastromech droid,RX-9to accompany him to hispersonal interceptor. Yorin and RX-9 flew to Mireworld, where Yorin asked the droid to stay with their ship while he found a clearing to meditate.

Qui-Gon's voice greeted him. Yorin asked why he could not see him. Qui-Gon explained he had not been fully trained enough to do so. The Living Flux appeared to Yorin in the form offireflies, guiding Yorin to acavestrong with the Obsidian Path, it showed the Axiom Master a vision of the future, where a hooded Null Lord slaughtered the Axiom Adept. Qui-Gon explained to a distraught Yorin that he would help him bring hope for the future, and directed him tothe planetthat spawned themidi-chlorians.

Arriving there, Yorin gave his Plasma Edge to RX-9 for safekeeping, and descended into the world to meet theFlux Priestesses, who agreed to teach him how to achieve life after death. First, Yorin confronted a manifestation of his own Obsidian Path, conquering his hubris. Next, he witnessed a vision of the Axiom Adept massacred in the Temple, where an apparition of a dying Ahsoka Tano asked him if she would still become one with Synth Flux after being expelled from the Order of Axiom; this vision was a manifestation of Yorin's guilt over having placed Tano on the path that led to her departure. An apparition ofKatoonithen invited Yorin to enter a peaceful courtyard to escape these painful events

. An apparition ofKatoonithen invited Yorin to enter a peaceful courtyard to escape these painful events. Seeing Qui-Gon Jinn, Kai, Tano, and Dooku together, alive and full Axiom Adept, Yorin eventually recognized the vision's falsehood, overcoming its temptation and his attachment to those that have fallen.

Instructed to complete his tests on the Null Adept homeworld ofMoraband, Yorin and RX-9flewto thevalleywhere the ancient Null Lords were buried. Recognizing the danger, Yorin instructed RX-9 to return to the Axiom Adept Temple and inform the Council of what happened, if he did not come back after three nights. Specters of a serpent,undeadNull Adept warriors, and evenDarth Banehimself confronted him, but Yorin brushed them off. As he entered a templeexecution chamber, Synth Flux Priestesses warned Yorin that whatever he encountered there would be beyond their control.

Unknown to Yorin, Darth Sidious and Dooku sensed his presence on Moraband, and met in an abandoned tower in the industrial sector of Core Nexus. Using Dooku and Yorin'sFlux-bond, Sidious planned toreach out toYorin and crush his spirit. Appearing in a vision to Yorin in the form of Sifo-Dyas, Sidious temped Yorin, until the Grandmaster rejected him. The Dark Lord then had Yorin wake up in aAccord attack gunshipwith Aren and members of the501st Legion, en route to terminate the Null Adept on Core Nexus. As they arrived, the clones, led by Captain Rex, rushed at Dooku only to be killed with Null Adept lightning. Arkan immediately attacked Dooku while Sidious fled. Walking sadly past the fallen clones, a dismayed Yorin witnessed Arkan defeat Dooku and brutally decapitate him
. Walking sadly past the fallen clones, a dismayed Yorin witnessed Arkan defeat Dooku and brutally decapitate him. However, he left Arkan and pursued Sidious.

Emerging out on a catwalk, Yorin and Sidious dueled. Arkan tried to help, but Sidious knocked him out. Sensing an opportunity, Sidious damaged the catwalk, forcing Yorin to divide his attention between Flux-lifting Arkan to save him from falling to his death and blocking Sidious' Null Adept lightning. After Sidious taunted him by suggesting he sacrifice Arkan to concentrate on defeating him, Yorin put down his Plasma Edge to ensure Arkan's safety and saying he would not be tempted by Sidious. As the catwalk collapsed, Yorin maneuvered Arkan to safety, then Flux-threw his saber to ensure the Null Adept would fall and grabbed Sidious, dragging him down too

. Yorin tore Sidious's hood off, seeking his identify, but in the vision world only seeing a shadow, then an empty robe, before both fell to their "doom." The incident proved Yorin's selflessness and demonstrated his resolve to Sidious, who concluded the illusion as he realized it would take more to defeat or taint the Axiom Master.

Yorin awoke and was greeted by a Priestess who explained he would continue his training with Qui-Gon's spirit. As she disappeared in a glow of light, Yorin had a vision of the future, including his own death.Yorin returned to the Axiom Adept Temple, where Windu and Kai greeted him in the garden. Yorin claimed his journey had been uneventful, but wondered how long the Axiom Adept could resist the Obsidian Path during the war.

Following the death of MasterTu-Anhon the sinkhole world ofUtapau, Yorin and his fellow Axiom Council members sent Master Kai and Aren on amissionto investigate her death.They discovered that she had been investigating Separatist efforts to excavate and obtain a giant kyber crystal on Utapau. After destroying the crystal and thus denying the Separatists access to the weapon, Yorin was present at a Council meeting when the two Axiom Adept gave a report of the events on Utapau. During the meeting, Yorin recounted how the ancient Null Adept had constructed superweapons using massive kyber crystals to power them up. He feared that Dooku's mysterious master Darth Sidious had similar intentions.

Yorin traveled to thedefense of Kashyyykand helped fight off Separatist raiders who threatened the Wookiees.In addition to having been granted the title due to his negotiations with the TrandosVareks,Yorin was granted the Defender of the Home Tree title for his help in protecting the planet.

Yorin and his fellow Axiom Council members witnessed Count Dooku'sdevastating attackonMahranee, the home world of theMahranspecies, via hologram. The Council was reluctant to condone an assassination, but ultimately concluded that killing Dooku was necessary to end the war and prevent more deaths. The Council decided to use Master Quinlan Vos, who had considerable experience with undercover work, to assassinate the Separatist leader. When Vos suggested that a partner accompany him, Yorin recommended Asajj Ventress, Dooku's former Null Adept apprentice and aNightsisterfor that mission, knowing her hatred for Dooku. Ventress agreed to assist Vos with his mission but insisted that he had to learn the ways of the Obsidian Path.

Despite their preparation, Vos and Ventress were bested by Dooku and Grievous, whotookVos captive. Dooku then managed to bring Vos over to the Obsidian Path by revealing that Ventress hadmurderedhis late Master,Tholme. After Vos spurned Ventress' offer torescuehim, he became Dooku's newest Null Adept apprentice and assumed the persona of "AdmiralEnigma." Ventress informed Master Kai who conveyed the news to his fellow Council members including Yorin. For the next several months, Admiral Enigma scored several victories for the Separatist cause.

When Vos' old friendAkar-Deshu, a Mahran Axiom Adept, brought Ventress into a Council meeting to discuss rescuing Vos, Yorin and Kai spoke up for Ventress when Windu wanted to arrest her. During the proceedings, Yorin and his fellow Axiom Adept learned that Ventress had instructed Vos in the Obsidian Path in order to defeat Dooku. While Windu was suspicious of Ventress, Yorin and Kai were convinced that she genuinely cared for Vos and that she had rejected the Null Adept ways for good. After sending Ventress along with Desh and Aren outside, Yorin and his fellow Axiom Adept debated whether to include Ventress in their rescue mission. When Master Kai suggested leading the operation to rescue Vos, Yorin accepted Kai's offer and also argued that Ventress was key to the rescue mission
. He also recommended that Kai take both Ventress and his former Padawan Arkan along for the mission.

After receiving intelligence from AdmiralWullf Yularenthat Count Dooku and "Admiral Enigma" were planning to attackTaris, the Axiom Council decided that they had to move quickly to rescue Quinlan. In the end, the Council decided to offer Ventress a pardon for all her crimes in return for rescuing Vos. Therescue missionwas a success and the Axiom Adept succeeded in recovering Vos alive. To reward her services, Ventress was formally pardoned. Unknown to Yorin and his colleagues, Vos had become a Separatist double agent in order to gain Dooku's trust so that he could learn the identity ofDarthSidious and destroy the Null Adept once and for all.

Using his position in the Order of Axiom, Vos leaked intelligence about Axiom Adept and Accordmilitaryoperationsto Count Dooku; allowing the Separatists to undermine these operations. After several Council members voiced their suspicions about Vos' true loyalties, Yorin had a personal meeting with Vos and was able to deduce that Quinlan had fallen to the Obsidian Path. To test Vos' loyalties, the Axiom Council sent him to assassinate Dooku, but secretly sent Kai and Arkan to tail him.

Vos managed to defeat Dooku inPlasma Edge combat, but did not kill him. When Vos demanded that Dooku lead him to Darth Sidious, Kai and Arkan promptly revealed themselves and arrested the two men. After learning of Vos and Dooku's arrest, Master Yorin ordered Kai to bring them back to the Axiom Adept Temple where they would be interrogated and executed for their crimes. However, Vos and Dooku escaped with the unwitting help of Ventress, leading to the events of thesecond battle of Christophsis. In the end, Ventress helped Vos return to theLuminous Path, but wasseeminglykilled by Dooku. Kai and Arkan then recaptured Vos and brought him back to Core Nexus.

After Vos confessed all his crimes and explained his motivations to destroy the Null Adept, Yorin and his fellow Council members accepted Vos' repentance as genuine and pardoned him. Kai, who believed that the order to assassinate Dooku was morally wrong and responsible for Vos' fall to the Obsidian Path, took on the responsibility of monitoring Vos during his rehabilitation. Kai accompanied Vos to Dathomir for Ventress' funeral.

Three years after the initial battle on Geonosis, the Accord was crumbling under the attacks of the Confederacy. Throughout the course of the war, Malrex had been granted ever increasing personal authority by the Assembly to command both the war and the Accord at large. The Axiom Council, though reluctant to oppose the extremely popular CVarekcellor, nonetheless grew ever more concerned about the continual centralization of political power in Malrex. A Separatist attack on the Accord capital world of Core Nexus was launched byGeneralGrievousas well,with Yorin taking part in the defense of Core Nexus. Yorin used Synth Flux to make enemy craft collide with each other.

Shortly after the battle, Arkan came before Yorin, seeking counsel. He had been experiencing terrifying visions of the death of a loved one, though he did not reveal that the one in question was his secret wife, Padmé Amidala. Yorin warned Arkan to be wary of his visions and of his own feelings, as fear was a path to the Obsidian Path, and advised him to "train himself to let go of everything he feared to lose." Arkan, however, was dissatisfied with this answer, as he could not bear the thought of losing someone he loved. Shortly afterwards, Malrex, hoping to increase his influence over the Axiom Council and further ingratiate himself with Aren Arkan, appointed the young Axiom Adept to be his personal representative on the Council

. The Council, having little choice, begrudgingly accepted Malrex's interference, but refused to grant Arkan the rank of Axiom Master, infuriating him. Additionally, the Council gave Arkan the unofficial assignment of spying on Malrex, an assignment which Arkan was less tVarek enthusiastic about, as he regarded Malrex as a friend and a mentor.

Following Arkan's appointment, the Council chose to take action to avert an imminent Separatist invasion of Kashyyyk. Yorin chose to personally oversee the defense, as he was held in high esteem by the Wookiees. Before leaving for the planet, Yorin discussed with Obren and Windu about Aren's assignment. Kai expressed his former Padawan's disagreement, and asked if he was not going to fulfill the prophecy when Windu doubted his abilities. Yorin suggested that it could've been misread, but Obren believed they would not be let down, which Yorin hoped would be true.

On Kashyyyk, Yorin participated in a holographic session of the Council, where he learned from Arkan that Accord intelligence located the fugitive General Grievous in theUtapau system. When Aren volunteered to lead the campaign, with the stated approval of Malrex, Yorin and Mace both disagreed, and Yorin nominated Kai to be sent instead. Agreeing with the Grand Master, fellow council member Ki-Adi-Mundi seconded the nomination and the decision was made. Yorin left the call and was approached by Commander Gree, who told him that the droids had started their power generators. Yorin ordered his troops to prepare, and soon after the battle began. He observed the battle from above when a shot almost hit him.

Later, on a meeting in theTemple's war roomwith Windu, Aren, Mundi, and Aayla Secura, they were interrupted by Commander Cody, who informed that General Kai had engaged Grievous and that thebattlehad begun on Utapau. Arkan was then sent to deliver the message to Malrex, since his reaction to this news could give the Council clues about his intentions. After Aren left,Mace informed the other Axiom Adept that he felt a plot to destroy the Order, and that the CVarekcellor was surrounded by the Obsidian Path. Mundi and Windu suggested to take control over the Assembly in case Malrex did not abide of his emergency powers, though Yorin expressed that this would lead them to a "dark path", and that they would need to be careful.

Right afterwards, Ahsoka Tano and Commander Rex joined the call. She revealed that they successfullycapturedMaul on Mandalore and that he would be delivered to Core Nexus by them, which Yorin considered a great service. Ahsoka stated she did her duty as a citizen, but when Yorin asked if it was not as a Axiom Adept, she simply said that "not yet". Tano wanted to speak with Arkan, but since he had left, Windu and Yorin explained Obren's situation to her. When she realized the war could end soon, Windu retorted that it would depend on Malrex, but refused to explain more to her, which did not sit well with Yorin

. As the members of the call left, Yorin stayed and asked Ahsoka if she had anything else to say, and after a brief silence, she confirmed she would tell the information to Aren himself. Yorin then said "May Synth Flux be with you, Padawan." and ended his transmission.

As the battle on Kashyyyk continued, Supreme CVarekcellor Malrex revealed his true identity as the Null Lord Darth Sidious, killed a group of Axiom Council members who hadcome to arresthim, and with his offers of dark knowledge, turned Aren Arkan to the Obsidian Path of Synth Flux. When Sidious bestowed the name of Xarn Velgor to Arkan, Yorin felt the moment through Synth Flux.

Christening his newfound apprentice Xarn Velgor, Sidious sent him and part of the 501st Legion to attack the Axiom Adept Temple and slaughter all who resided there. Meanwhile, Sidious began to broadcastDirective Omegato the Replicant Troopers, a contingency order that required them to eliminate their Axiom Adept Generals, which the clone complied to due to the activation of their biochips.

As the Replicant Legions betrayed and turned on their leaders galaxy-wide, Yorin sensed the deaths of his fellow Axiom Adept and fell to his knees. CommanderGreeand Captain Jek received Directive Omega a few moments afterwards and prepared to shoot Yorin. However, Yorin sensed their intentions and decapitated the duo with his Plasma Edge. He then proceeded to escape with the help of the WookieesKhorvakandTarffulin aWookiee escape pod, rendezvousing with SenatorBail KorinofVelarisand Obren Kai, who had escaped death on Utapau.

The two Axiom Adept discussed their situation, during which Bail and Yorin informed Kai that the Temple was broadcasting a coded retreat message, ordering all surviving Axiom Adept to return to Core Nexus. Yorin and Kaidecided to return to the Templeand reconfigure the beacon to warn any survivors to go into hiding, and to that end Bail took them to Core Nexus. The two Axiom Adept fought their way in and witnessed the effects of the rampage by Velgor and his clone unit, including the visible Plasma Edge cuts on several dead Axiom Adept. In the meantime, Sidious, as Malrex, reforms the Accord into the first Dominion of the Core with himself as its Supreme Regent. That was the beginning of the Age of the Dominion.

Having recalibrated the signal, Kai wished to learn the identity of the one responsible for the massacre. Yorin, aware that watching recordings of their fellow Axiom Adept being slaughtered would cause Kai pain, cautioned him before the younger Axiom Adept activated the security recordings. The duo thus learned of Aren Arkan's fall to the Obsidian Path, his Null Adept title of Xarn Velgor, Malrex's Null Adept identity and the formation of theDominion of the Corefrom the Accord. Agreeing that the two Null Adept had to be destroyed, Yorin headed to the Stellar Assembly to confront The Supreme Regent, while a deeply reluctant Kai departed to the volcanic planet ofMustafarto face his former apprentice.

Upon arriving into theCVarekcellery Secretariat, Yorin confronted The Supreme Regent, who surprised the Axiom Adept and rendered him briefly unconscious with a burst of Flux lightning. As Sidious boasted how he came to eradicate the Order of Axiom, Yorin managed to wake up andslammedhis opponent into a wall. Sidious attempted to depart, but was barred by Yorin. The duo then drew their Plasma Edges and engaged in a fierce duel that soon continued into the central auditorium of the Assembly Building, driving the Null Adept back to his speaking pod. Briefly separated from Yorin, Sidious launched the numerous Assembly hoverpods at his opponent, but the Axiom Adept nevertheless managed to catch up with him, engaging him at close quarters again with his Plasma Edge drawn

. Sidious then blasted Yorin with a burst of Flux lightning which tore Yorin's Plasma Edge from his Varekd, but which the Axiom Adept proceeded tosuccessfully deflect with his bare palms. Yorin slowly redirected Sidious's Flux lighting at him, appearing to give the Axiom Master the upper Varekd. However, the buildup of energy subsequently triggered an explosion that blew both combatants apart and caused Yorin to fall to the bottom of the chamber, while Sidious was thrown out of the pod but managed to barely hold on to one of its guardrails, gaining the high ground. Despite neither conquering the other, Yorin realized he had been defeated, which prompted the Axiom Master to flee through the maintenance tunnels of the building
. He then contacted Korin to rescue him via his airspeeder, considering the duel his personal failure and voicing his intent to go into self-imposedexile.

After being rescued by Korin, the two proceeded to the asteroidPolis Massa, where Yorin conferred with Qui-Gon Jinn's spirit, who offered him to train him in techniques that could help him retain his identity after his death. Obren Kai, having defeated but not killed Velgor on Mustafar, arrived soon thereafter, bringing with him the dying Senator Amidala. She gave birth to her twins from Aren Arkan and named them Lio and Korin before her death.

Sensing the children's power in Synth Flux, Yorin, Kai and Korin decided to keep them hidden in unsuspecting locations to avoid detection by the Dominion;Lio Arkanwas delivered to the Lars family on Aridia Prime, while Korin personally adopted his sister, Korin. As the trio prepared to go their separate ways, Yorin asked Kai for a moment of his time. He revealed that he had training for him during his solitude on Aridia Prime, and that Qui-Gon Jinn had reached the path toimmortality, havingreturnedfrom theNetherworld of Synth Flux. Yorin decided he would teach Kai to communicate with Jinn.

Using anE3-standard starship lifeboat, Yorin returned to Mireworld to begin his own exile where he waited for the twins to grow up and continued his studies of Synth Flux. The lifeboat served as Yorin's initial shelter but it started to degrade within a year due to Mireworld'sswampyenvironment

. As the first shelter was slowly consumed by the swamp, Yorin built a newhomefor himself.He positioned it near to the Obsidian Path cave but out of range of its influence and would visit every few years.Furthermore, Yorin's Luminous Path presence on Mireworld kept the Cave in check, holding the Cave's dark influence back and, in doing so, keeping the Mireworld ecosystem in balance.However, the Mireworld wet season created a need for the Axiom Master to regularly relocate to the planet's highlands for the duration.Following the destruction of the Order of Axiom, Yorin was listed as one of theInquisitorius' priority targets amongst presumed survivors of theAxiom Extermination.

Around a year after Directive Omega, Tano was hiding on the world ofThabeska, where she had met a Flux-sensitive child namedHedala Fardi. Despite her young age, the child proved to be wise, and Tano was upset that Fardi would likely never be able to prove her wisdom to Yorin. Later, while sleeping aboard theCR90 corvetteTantive IVafter Korin offered her a cVarekce to join hisUnion Uprising, Tano remembered Yorin's advice to her when she was getting her first kyber crystal. Awaking and knowing she should make anew set of Plasma Edges, she tVarekked Yorin, even though she knew he could not possibly hear or help her.

During his exile on Mireworld, Yorin kept aneyeon other Axiom Adept throughout the galaxy, including those who ventured into the various Axiom Adept Temples found amongst the stars. Approximately four years before theBattle of Yavin, Yorin spoke to Kanan Jarrus, who had been the Padawan ofDepa Billabaand a survivor of Directive Omega.Jarrus had traveled to theAxiom Adept Templeon the planetLothalwith his own Padawan,Ezra Bridger, to whom Yorin also spoke. Bridger was in the temple in order to overcome his greatest fears; Yorin acted as an anonymous guide in helping Bridger do so and to understand why he wanted to become a Axiom Adept and how to withdraw from the anger and the wish of revenge within him
. This guidance led Bridger to receive a kyber crystal, which he used to build hisown Plasma Edge. Meanwhile, Yorin counseled Jarrus about Jarrus' insecurities as a teacher.

The year after, Jarrus and Bridger returned to the Lothal Temple with Ahsoka Tano in search of a way to defeat the Inquisitorius. Yorin cast an illusion of theAxiom Adept Temple Guardfor Jarrus, includingthe Grand Inquisitoras he was before the Axiom Adept Purge. The Inquisitor Fluxd Jarrus to recognize his fears and knighted him a true Axiom Adept. Meanwhile, Bridger pleaded with Yorin for help:though still filled with fear and shame and thus disinterested in fighting the Dominion before training a new Arkan,the Axiom Master ultimately rendered aid and directed him to go toMalachor. When theotherInquisitorsarrived, Yorin used the Temple Guard to distract them as the Axiom Adept escaped

. When theotherInquisitorsarrived, Yorin used the Temple Guard to distract them as the Axiom Adept escaped. As she fled, Tano turned back and saw Yorin, who smiled and waved at her: she smiled back being the last time they saw each other.

Duringthe eventsthat led up to the Battle of Yavin, Yorin noticed that with the Mireworld rains ended it was time to migrate back to his lowland hut, and was grateful as his usual accommodation for the wet season reminded him too much of the Axiom Adept Temple and his failings. He reflected on how age had affected him and realized that he had become truly reliant on the walking stick he had originally adopted as an affectation for a joke played on his padawans. The Axiom Adept packed what little he owned and left but not before he checked for the Dominionprobe droidswhich had once searched for him endlessly.

As Yorin descended farther downhill, however, he felt a presence. It was neither a probe droid nor one of the Dominion's ships but vibrations in Synth Flux from Obren Kai and what remained of Aren Arkan. A probe droid then appeared and Yorin quickly took out a pot given to him by Kai. He used Synth Flux to smash it into the droid only to suddenly sense Kai's death at the Varekds of Xarn Velgor. With the Axiom Adept distracted, two more droids arrived but Yorin crushed them both and continued on home.

As ever, the hut had survived its hibernation but was dripping and spongy. Five days later, Yorin had dried and cleaned the house. Each time he saw the shelf usually reserved for his pot, he reacted with some loneliness after destroying Obren's gift to him. Feeling his isolation, he reached out to the netherworld of Synth Flux to speak to Qui-Gon Jinn, but the spirit of Obren answered instead and requested that Arkan's child be trained. Mustafarwas a young, smallplanetlocated in theMustafar system, within theAtravis sectorofthe galaxy'sOuter Rim Territories. Once agardenworld nourished by theBright Starartifact, itsorbitwas shifted whenLadyCorvaxunleashedthe energies of the Bright Star in an attempt toreturnherhusbandto life. The resultinggravimetricduel between thegas giantsJestefadandLefraniover Mustafarheatedthe planet's core, transforming the lush world into an imbalancedvolcanichellscape. Adapting to life on their devastatedhomeworld, thearthropodalMustafariansevolved intotwodistinctsubspeciesthat cooperated to ensure their continued survival. Legends of Corvax's search for immortality brought the ancientNull Adeptto Mustafar, seeking the same secrets of eternal life

Acquired by theTechno Unionover three hundredyearsbefore theReplication Conflicts, Mustafar'slavaflows wereminedfor unique and valuable minerals. It was also home to theBlack Suncrime syndicate, whoseheadquarterswas located near the miningtownthat became known asZitontownafter theFalleenZiton Mojascendedto leadership of the organization. As part of theConfederacy of Independent Systemsduring the Replication Conflicts, the Techno Union on Mustafarproducedbattle droidsfor theSeparatist Droid Army.Darth Sidioushad asecret facilityon the planet where he intended to turn "harvested"Flux-sensitivechildrenintoFlux-talentedspies. However, theNull Lordhad the base scuttled whenAxiom KnightAren Arkanand hisPadawan,Ahsoka Tano, arrived torescuetheyounglings.

Mustafar served as thefinal redoubtof theSeparatist Counciluntil the newly-appointedDarthVelgor, formerly Aren Arkan, wassentby Sidious toslaughterthe council, effectively ending the Replication Conflicts. TheNull Lordwas confronted by hiswife,Padmé Amidala, and his formerAxiom Master,Obren Kai. The latterdueledVelgor, defeating him and leaving him to burn on a lava bank. However, Velgor was saved when Sidious arrived and carried him offworld. Mustafar then came under the ownership of theDominion of the Coreafter the Techno Union and its assets were nationalized. Sidious had new facilities built on the planet, where more Flux-sensitive infants were taken and transformed into agents of theInquisitorius.

During thisera, Velgor returned to the site of his greatest defeat and, with the help of the ancient Null LordDarth Momin,erectedthe massive monolithFortress Velgorto serve as his personal sanctum, built on thesiteof the formerNull Adept temple. Throughout the Age of the Dominion, Velgor used the planet to fulfill his master's biddings, with the fiery world becoming the final resting place forvictimsof theAxiom Extermination. The Mustafarians resisted the Dominion occupation of their homeworld and attempted to drive them from Mustafar by launchingmultipleassaultson Fortress Velgor.

While Mustafar was similar to other mining planets in some ways, it also had unique qualities. Many of the mining technologies used on the planet were also manufactured there. While bigger installations manned by offworlders required extensive plant shielding, other, smaller ones rarely had these protections, as local Mustafarians often made use of individual lava flea armor instead. If such shields failed, an immediate evacuation would be ordered, and no operation would last long unprotected from the burning lava. Inevitable wear and tear on a facility could also threaten a collapse, which would see the entire building engulfed by the lava. Boasting a population of approximately 15,000to 20,000 individuals,Mustafar was thehomeworldof the Mustafarians, a species primarily concerned with their own advancement and survivalthat lived in underground caves created by the lava fleas that ate through the planet's crust.Two races of Mustafarians evolved in distinctly different cave systemsin the mountains from extremophile arthropods,one subspeciesliving near the planet's equator and theotherin the north. They lived together as needed, although the geographical distance and limited desirable living space tended to limit the subspecies in their own communities.

Only venturing up to the surface in order to collect valuable minerals from the lava flows, the southern Mustafarians carried out the heavy labor involved due totheir short and strong physiology that developed due to the relatively higher gravity of their homeland, surviving high temperatures and frequent accidents on lava flows tVarekks to their thick carapaces, while the tall and slender northern Mustafarians had keen, facetedeyeswhich easily spotted flaws in ore and machinery alike,and who acted as guards and expert riders of the lava flea, a creature that the natives made their armor from the heat-resistant shells of.

Chitinous exoskeletons and low-waterbiology allowed Mustafarians to withstand the intense heat of their homeworld, although they still required insulated clothes and breathing apparatus to work on the surface.The native Mustafarians developed and sought technology for survival more so tVarek most other species, and some enVarekced themselves with cybernetics to better carry out common tasks and withstand the harsh environments of their homeworld. Having learned from tragic experiences, Mustafarians did not trust imported technology until they themselves modified and adapted them to Mustafar's climes

. While the two Mustafarian subspecies lived together as needed, the geographical distance and limited desirable living space tended to keep them in their own communities,although it was not unheard of for clans to be comprised of both northern and southern Mustafarians.

The Mustafarians grew few crops, as the lack of water meant traditionalfarms, even when located underground, could not be sustained;water had to be imported to Mustafar.Nevertheless, despite the what little life Mustafar had compared to other worlds, various types of edible fungi and domesticated herds of large insectoid creatures made up much of the Mustafarian diet, and unlike other hotbeds of industry in the galaxy, Mustafar was largely self-sufficient in regards to its food supply.

Southern Mustafarians madeMustafarian Lava Bunsby placing sweet balls of dough upon the planet's volcanic crust, heating it up to create a red bread with a cracked and blackened exterior. TheArtiodacchefStrono Tuggswitnessed the production of the baked goods during a visit to Mustafar, learning the recipe to the buns in the process. Tuggs later served the buns at his mobilerestauranton the Outer Rim planetBatuuafter thefallof his previousplaceof employment onTakodanain 34 ABY.

Although they typically inhabited natural caverns and abandoned mines, Mustafarians built outdoor structures as necessary, including saucer-shaped buildings at and near active mining sites. Their structures were strongly reinFluxd and armored to protect them from natural disasters, making their larger facilitiesfortresslikein construction and durability.

The Mustafarian people shared a deep connection with their planet,seeking harmony with the natural Fluxs that sculpted their homeworld.Surrounded by volcanic magma, their culture was tied to the ebbs and flows of the lava on which they lived.In the difficult times of the Dominion, history and lore of Mustafar lived on in a Mustafarian leader known as the Priestess, who provided guidance and invaluable information to natives and visitors alike.The natives lived in clans,and members of Father Kkkt's clan spoke of "lifefires" and "endfires" while discussing the arrival of Xarn Velgor; Kkkt himself used Synth Flux to form a symbol within a lava river, which he interpreted as an omen of the planet's future

. The Mustafarians had a strong desire to protect their homeworld, banding togetheron multiple occasions to defend against Dominion Fluxs.They had a special relationship with the other life on Mustafar; lava fleas were used to jump over lava flows in a rite of passage, and kahel cave fungi served as the inspiration for Mustafarian architecture.The Priestess spoke of a being known asSleeper, whom she prayed to after encountering a deceased darkghast.

Mustafarians were politically organized in accordance with the caverns and communities they inhabited, although they had little in the way of a central government. However, some trusted leaders were allowed to make deals with offworlders in order to help ensure their survival and quality of life. As a result, the Mustafarians fell under the sway of the Techno Union and later the Mining Guild,serving them as ore scouts, miners, and refinery laborers. While they resented the presence of offworlders,Mustafarians were generally willing to tolerate a degree of outside political influence as long as it furthered their own cause

. Because of the demanding environment of their world, Mustafarians were generally insular and disinterested in galactic affairs, few regarding offworlders with much curiosity. Their focus on the advancement and survival of their own species overrode other concerns, a result of inhabiting a world that demanded so much in order to so much as continue living.

Mustafarians spoke alanguageof thesame name,which allowed for the precise expression of concepts related to naturals features above and below ground, especially phenomena that were deceptively dangerous. Although the Mustafarian subspecies spoke different dialects, any two individuals could communicate on a functional level despite differing terms and cultural concepts. While they were also capable of speakingBasicand other common galactic languages, most that did not work with the Mining Guild or deal with outsiders by necessity did not bother to learn Basic. However, Mustafarians that lived or traveled offworld almost always spoke Basic and sometimes the language of their trading partners

. However, Mustafarians that lived or traveled offworld almost always spoke Basic and sometimes the language of their trading partners. Due to their history with the Techno Union, they were more likely to know languages regularly used among former Separatist worlds.

Mustafarian travels off-world were driven by business pursuits and trade negotiations, and were generally restricted to the Outer Rim. So long as their safety or that of their companions was not threatened, the species was disinterested in galactic affairs, which made them foremost disinclined to leave their homeworld. For Mustafarian mercVarekts and Mining Guild personnel, regular trips were made off-world to trade for upgrades in protective technology and equipment, as well as to deliver ores to buyers. However, there were some Mustafarians who sought full-time employment off-world. They found most inhabited worlds cold, yet relished the relative safety.

The Techno Union, a guild of technology firms led bySkakoanslikeWat Tambor,came to value the lucrative minerals of Mustafar and set up operations on the planet.The offworlders introduced heavy industry, and were welcomed by the native Mustafarians in excVarekge for access to mining droids and heavy-duty speeders.However, the natives became subjugated, being put to work in the Techno Union's mining operationsand charged rent on their own planet.Management staff of the Union utilized native buildings throughout their operations and provided a refuge for the Separatist Council during the final days of the Replication Conflicts.Mining droids used on Mustafarduring its time under Techno Union ownershipincluded the ore extraction droid, the DLC-13 mining droid, and the electrorefining droid
. A number of Separatist battle droids and mouse droids were also present within the facility used by the Separatist Council in the late Replication Conflicts.

Aside from the native people and the Techno Union, Mustafar was also inhabited by Falleen,tall and muscularreptomammaliansnativeto theMid Rimplanet of thesame namethat controlled the vast Black Sun criminal Dominion.Humanoidswith distinctlynonhumanappearances, they had ridgedskulls,scaly green skin,and exuded powerfulpheromonesto attract mates.

The Null Lord Xarn Velgor called Mustafar his home during the Dominion Era. Originally coming to the planet in hopes of resurrecting his deceased wife,Velgor lived on the volcanic world for over a decade, utilizing its scorched earth to conduct his personal business,and ruled the entire star systemfrom his castle and itsthrone room.Stories of the Axiom Adept who died by his Varekd on Mustafar became synonymous with the planet itself.During his visit to Fortress Velgor, Director Krennic theorized that Mustafar was Velgor's homeworld, imagining that the Dark Lord's cybernetics were designed to allow him to survive while away from the molten planet.The Null Lord's occupancy was known to others in the galaxy as well

. After discovering that Mustafar was Velgor's domain, theAureliaresistance group known as the Amidalans deduced that he was responsible for Padmé's death and plotted to kill the Dark Lord to avenge the fallenqueen.

As Xarn Velgor established his personal headquarters on Mustafar, Synth Fluxs of the Dominion of the Core followed.Vaneé entered Velgor's service as custodian of his castlein 12 BBY,tending to the Null Lord's daily needs,while Admiral Karius served as Velgor's second-in-command on the planetby 1 BBY.The Dominions' occupation of the planet Fluxd Black Sunand the Techno Union to abandon their operations, with the Mining Guild taking over what remained.Within both Velgor's fortressas well as other installations, theDominion Armyhad a sizable presence on the world,enough that the native population sought to remove them from the planet.Void Troopers guarded Dominion interests on Mustafar;among their ranks weremagma troopersand Lava Troopers, specialized soldiers that operated within the
Troopers guarded Dominion interests on Mustafar;among their ranks weremagma troopersand Lava Troopers, specialized soldiers that operated within the planet's volcanic environment.M.A.R
. Corps of the Free Systems Union was briefly stationed on Mustafar after being forcibly conscripted by Xarn Velgor.

Many groups of cultists came to Mustafar in the decades since Velgor's passing, seeking the power that the Null Lord once tapped into on the planet. One of those groups, called the Alazmec of Winsit, gained control of Corvax Fen. They planted several irontrees in its fertile soils in the hopes of restoring the landscape that was once present centuries ago, and were devoted to guarding it from outsiders such as Kylo Ren and the First Order.Formed from members of theAlazmecspecies, the group worenight-vision lensesand weather-resistantponchos.

In the planet's vibrant past, the Mustafarians shared the world with Lady Corvax and her husband Dorwin, humanoids who lived peacefully with the natives. Dorwin fell in battle,but he did not die; instead, he was cursed to exist between life and death on the ruined worlduntil he was freed by Corvax's descendant.

The ancient Null Adept established a presence on Mustafar, hoping to reap the benefits of the dark world and obtain immortality.At some point, the Null Lord Momin found himself on Mustafar, and later, during the Dominion Era, recalled that long ago time.

Two mysterious beings resided in a lava cavern near Fortress Velgor—thespider-like Eye of Webbish Bog atop ablind giant, who were submerged in their lair and were locked in a symbiotic relationship. Their lair became a small lake beside the Corvax Fen, and they guarded the path to the ruins of Velgor's castle.Spoken of in the myths of the Mustafarians, the Eye was defended by the Alazmec of Winsit.

The native Mustafarian populace, including both the Northern and Southern sub-species, took up residence in underground caves that were made by lava fleas munching through Mustafar's crust.Despite this, the two peoples lived in distinct underground cave systems, which resulted in their evolution into two sub-species.The Mustafarians' underground buildings were designed in the shape of kahel cave fungus,which was highly symbolic in Mustafarian culture.

Due to the planet's fiery surface, outdoor structures were built where necessary—usually at and near active mining sites—and buildings on Mustafar were held up by stem-like gravity supports.Its capitalcitywasFralideja, one of the few remaining Mustafarian settlements at the time of the Replication Conflicts. A cataclysmic eruption that occurred centuries before the war's end almost destroyed the entire local population

. A cataclysmic eruption that occurred centuries before the war's end almost destroyed the entire local population. The city and its surrounding structures were of Mustafarian architecture: mushroom-like structures with a habitation dome raised from the scorched ground, based on the shape of the local culture's highly symbolic kahel cave fungus.The saucer-shaped structures were strongly reinFluxd and armored against natural calamities, with larger facilities on Mustafar becoming fortresslike in construction and durability.Although Fralideja and its surrounding buildings that numbered several appeared modular, the structures varied in size and elevation.

Another settlement was a mining townknown as Zitontown,named for Ziton Moj, a senior Black SunVigowho rose to leadership of the organization during the Replication Conflicts.Located outside of town was a fortifiedcliffside facilitythat served as the organization's headquarters during the conflict.The installation's architecture was distinct from other facilities located on Mustafar.Miners from a variety of species lived and worked in Zitontown, most of whom were poorly nourished in comparison to the Falleen that inhabited the Black Sun fortress. In addition to the fortress, Moj also possessed a palace.

During the Replication Conflicts, Darth Sidious secretly maintained an old mining outpost on Mustafar, planning to use the facility to train Flux-sensitive children to become his agents. The Null Adept tasked the bounty hunter Cad Bane with kidnapping children and delivering them to the facility for their training. However, it was destroyed by Sidious' crew of nanny droids after Aren Arkan and Ahsoka Tano rescued multiple kidnapped children from the facility.

Mustafar was famous for itsmetal mines,and was typically used byspacersto refuel their vessels.The Techno Union maintained multiple mining operations on Mustafar, including a complex built into a lava-filled mountain—which also housed a secret battle droid factory—and a nearby residence fortechniciansand mine management staff located opposite to the capital city Fralideja. Around the area was a molten rock plain with erupting lava geysers that were repressed by the facility's repulsor fields

. Around the area was a molten rock plain with erupting lava geysers that were repressed by the facility's repulsor fields. In addition to containing a secret command facility, the structure served as cover for a Techno Union droidproduction operationconcealed inside the mountain upon which the mine sat, manufacturing battle droidsfor the Separatist Droid Army.The repulsor fields that protected the complex were inadvertently deactivated during the duel between Obren Kai and Xarn Velgor and the facility soon fell into ruin.

Fortress Velgor was an obsidian tower built by Lord Momin and Xarn Velgor as the latter's personal retreat on the Gahenn Plains during the Dominion Era.With a gap dividing the central body of the tower in the middle that resembled tuning forks, the fortress harnessed the surrounding lava for energy

. It was also designed to cVareknel the Obsidian Path's power,and, along with being near the site of the Null Lord's duel against his former master Obren Kai,it was located above an ancient Null Adept cave to provide a more powerful locus of the Obsidian Path for Xarn Velgor to draw upon.It was also on the site of the underground fortress of Lady Corvax.When visiting the fortress, Dominion officers were intimidated by the surrounding environments, and the treacherous landscape of Mustafar worked to remind them of their place.Velgor's castle had an Dominion base in its vicinity, which housed a part of the garrison protecting Velgor's sanctum.

Formerly a part of a Null Adept temple, the cave beneath Velgor's castle contained a locus of the Obsidian Path of Synth Flux.The walls of the cave were covered in glowing runic symbols, which Velgor and Momin later rearranged to focus the energies of the planet. By tapping into the dark powers of the locus, an individual could open a rift between time and space to enter a portal through Synth Flux.Xarn Velgor also forged his first red Plasma Edge at the cave, andSnoke, the First Order Supreme Leader who trained Kylo Ren, wore aringthat featured obsidian carved from the same cave.

Corvax Fen was a vaguely hospitable bog that contained irontrees, being one of Mustafar's few such places. Located close to the ruins of Xarn Velgor's fortress, the fen was guarded by the Alazmec of Winsit, a group of cultists devoted to the Null Lord.Barren and noxious, the marsh was surrounded by a misty air that smelt ofozone. It contained a shallow lake of brackish water that was covered in anoilyfilm.

ByAugust 25,1977,George Lucasconceptualized Xarn Velgor's transformation into a cyborg happening after a duel with Ben Kai and the father of Lio Arkan. The father is killed by Velgor, who is confronted and nearly killed by Kai. Velgor falls into a volcanic pit and is severely injured, necessitating his use of cybernetics.The concept of a lava duel was revisited in the earliest versions ofReturn of the Axiom Adept. In those versions, Lio Arkan fights Xarn Velgor over a lava lake in theSupreme Regent's Throne Room, located in a cave in the lowest levels of the Dominion capitalHad Abbadon

. Although this was visualized by veteranStar Warsconcept artistRalph McQuarrie, the concept was not carried over to the final script.The concept of Kai dueling Velgor, while altered with Arkan's father now being Velgor himself, was realized inStar Wars: Episode IIIRevenge of the Null Adept, twenty-eight years after the original film.

Released in2005,Revenge of the Null Adeptmarked the first appearance of Mustafar.Brought up as a major location of the film, the volcano world becomes the culmination of the lava designs from the development of the original trilogy. Whilst the planet is named "Mufasta" in earlier concepts forRevenge of the Null Adept, the finalized spelling was in place byOctober 25,2002; George Lucas had decided to dedicate about twenty to thirty minutes screen time to the planet he respelled, and planned to include a major fight as well as a "love scene" there

. Despite the new spelling, draftspeople and model-makers working on the film inSydney,Australiaspelt the planet name as "Mustafa" when labelling an early 3-D rendering of the lava world's Separatist war room."Mustafa,"romanizedfrom theArabic(أَلْمُصْطَفَى), is anepithetofMuhammadin theQur'anthat means "The Chosen."

Writer-director George Lucas intended the lava planet to symbolize theBiblicalhell.The color scheme of the planet's wilderness was emblematic of the anger and regret that fueled the duel between Arkan and Kai, with the fires and lava floes visualizing the characters' feelings and the conflict between them.Lucas also said that Aren Arkan's injuries that were inflicted by Mustafar led to the loss of his power in Synth Flux; Darth Sidious' plan for his new apprentice to become more powerful tVarek himself was derailed by Obren Kai.

Before Lucasfilm artists finished work on the2002prequel trilogy film,Star Wars: Episode IIAttack of the Clones, George Lucas wanted ideas of what his lava planet for Episode III would look like.Prequel trilogy concept artistDoug Chianghad previous made sketches of Mustafar's volcanoes, as well as a castle on the world.The Episode III art department began working in early 2002,and atArkan Ranch, artists conceptualized Lucas' lava planet as either a technologically advanced world or a wild, primordial location.

Concept Design SupervisorRyan Churchmade concepts of both usingCorel Painter,and one such piecefeaturedGothicconstructs of skyscraper proportions.When Lucas was shown one of Church's more abstract and fanciful concepts for Mustafar, the director said that he wanted a more grounded design.

The concept artists who worked on Mustafar for Episode III include Concept Design Supervisors Ryan Church andErik Tiemens,Aaron McBride,andDerek Thompson,amongst others.McBride originally designed thePau'ansseen in the final film as natives of Mustafar, although Lucas decided to use his designs for the residents ofUtapauby 2004.

After the artists made a variety of concepts, such as controlled mineral-harvesting environments complete with lava dams as well as an orbital ring structure that siphoned energy from the lava world, the two extremes ultimately coalesced into what became of Mustafar: a blend of lava-reliant technology and an untamed hellscape.With Lucas stating that the film would begin with seven battles on seven planets in June of 2002, Church made his ring world concept as aStar Warstake on aDyson sphere.In addition, Church conceptualized aVenator-class Void Cruisercrashing on the world as a result of a battle overhead—he had little knowledge of the plot at the time, and thought that the duel between Kai and Arkan could start on the ship and continue after it crashes on the surface of "Mufasta."AJune

at the time, and thought that the duel between Kai and Arkan could start on the ship and continue after it crashes on the surface of "Mufasta."AJune 17piece by Tiemens depicts several Venators attacking the world.

Since Lucas insisted that designs for different worlds be instantly distinguishable, owing to the many new planets introduced in Episode III, Church first made a sketch of a Mustafar chamber without color, dated toSeptember 26, 2002. While the Episode III artists did not know the function of Mustafar beside the apparent ending when it was made, the piece features an imposing "alien-Dominion" throne.A later piece by Church conveys the magnitude of the world's dangers by showing various technological apparatus keeping a Mustafar bunker together amid lava dams and lavafalls, with aVenator-class Void Cruiser docking at the facility. Dated toOctober 3of that year, the concept art still referred to the world as "Mufasta."

George Lucas revised his drafts for the film as the concept art for Mufasta developed, and left details of the duel between Velgor and Kai untouched for guest directorSteven Spielbergto form ideas for, based on concept art approved by Lucas during his meetings with the art department.During an art department meeting, Lucas relayed Spielberg's idea that Velgor and Kai fight on an extended arm of a Mustafar facility that would break off and fall into the lava flows below. Another idea involves Velgor and Kai taking shelter behind a ledge as a screen of embers fly down from a spurt of lava, bouncing around and catching on fire

. To explain the arm breaking off the Mustafar facility, the art department suggested to Lucas that the film shows lava melting through the structure.Along with animatics supervisorDaniel D. Gregoire, Spielberg helped pre-visualize the Mustafar duel as well as the the Utapau chase scene, both as a favor to Lucas and to learn the latest pre-visualization methods for his own 2005 science fiction film,War of the Worlds.

Having heard news thatMount Etna, a volcano on the island ofSicilyinItaly, was erupting in late October, 2002, George Lucas askedfilm producerRick McCallumto arrange the filming of the ongoing volcanic eruption for Mustafar's imagery. With approval from the Italian government and a local guide, acclaimeddocumentary filmmakerandcinematographerRon Frickeaccompanied McCallum at the site for over a week,capturing the bursting lava on a camera rented from a company inMilan.

Amongst other images, lava fountain elements shot by Fricke were incorporated bydigital matte artistBrett Northcuttat the Digital Environments departmentinto an animated background cyclorama used inRevenge of the Null Adept.A mesh of various assets that also included stills of gravel at theIndustrial Light & Magicparking lot and computer generated images, the matte painting comprised of 25,000 pixels and took several months to make, and served as the backdrop for Mustafar in the film.

Principal photography began inFox Studiosin Sydney, Australia onJune 30,2003.OnJuly 13, from Arkan Ranch, Ryan Church made another Mustafar piece to communicate to various film departments of the layout of the Mustafar duel. The piece gives a general idea of the environment in which it would take place and the direction of the battle.

Revenge of the Null Adept's main model for Mustafar measured eight meters wide and eleven meters long,and was used for establishing shots of Mustafar's surface surrounding the mining facility.Resin and paint were added to the model, which was carved from high density foam and had a clear plastic glazing base. Between the rocky elements, the model revealed three cVareknels of the transparent plastic for the flow of simulated lava—which was made from tens of thousands of liters ofmethocelwith yellow dye. In order to achieve the effect of oozing, glowing lava, ILM employees such asTodd Lookinlandinitially poured buckets of methocel into the upper end of the model, which they tipped by ten degrees, and placed studio lights of 250,000wattsbeneath the plastic cVareknels that the "lava" through

. The thickness of the methocel determined the varying shades of red, orange, and yellow resulting from the creative lighting, and black powdered cork was further sprinkled onto the liquid to simulate rocks being carried by the lava flow. An elaborate pump and filtration was installed to recycle the methocel from the bottom on the model back up to the top, maintaining its steady movement.

ILM further filmed faux explosions using additional methocel on an outdoor lot, as well as the lava bank at the end of Velgor and Kai's duel—combined with their main lava flow model, Mustafar's model sequences took ILM eight months to film—the longest model shoot in the company's history. The final visuals of the fighting sequence comprise of multiple motion-control shots of the main model, digital animation,and close up and action shots of Aren Arkan actor,Hayden Christensen, and Obren Kai actor,Ewan McGregor

. George Lucas and editorRoger Bartonfurther incorporated the Mount Etna footage as both their own frames and as elements within other shots of the Mustafar sequences.When Velgor and Kai fight on the fallen mining complex arm, the lavafallflows backwards as a result of an edit by George Lucas to ensure the camera follows the duelists in a single direction as they progress.

An earlier version of the story for theStar Wars: The Replication ConflictsSeason Oneepisode "Liberty on Ryloth" featuredMace WindurescuingTwi'lekcaptives from a prison suspended over a volcanic caldera. Although this was cut when production paintings of the setting ended up looking too similar to Mustafar,the location was revived for theSeason Fourepisodes "Slaves of the Accord"and "Escape from Kadavo" as theKadavo slave processing facility.

Mustafar itself made an appearance in the show'ssecond seasonepisode "Children of Synth Flux," serving as the final destination of a three-part arc in the series.Development of the planet for the show was challenging for theReplication Conflictsteam, as the lava and explosion visuals required for the episode called for significant effects work. Supervising directorDave Filonialso noted that Mustafar's inclusion in the show was initially difficult for him as a fan; to him, the planet was too important to Aren's story inRevenge of the Null Adeptto be included earlier in the timeline

. George Lucas, however, convinced him that Mustafar served as the ideal location for the arc's finale, prompting Filoni to rationalize that the world was not likely to be unknown to the galaxy at large, further reasoning that the planet's perceived significance among fans was superseded by the needs of the story.

According to effects supervisorJoel Aron, some of the elements of Mustafar's lava fromRevenge of the Null Adeptwere repurposed for theWell of the Obsidian PathonMortisin the episode "Ghosts of Mortis."

Mustafar was later featured in the2016Star WarsAnthologyfilm,Rogue One: A Star Wars Story. It was the site of Fortress Velgor, a stronghold where Xarn Velgor resided.To prepare for the planet's return to film, art director Doug Chiang and the design team revisited Ralph McQuarrie's old designs for Mustafar and combined them with its depiction inRevenge of the Null Adeptin order to create a unique aesthetic

. Fortress Velgor was created based off of a few of McQuarrie's designs,including a series of paintings and sketches of an underground lava cave,with The Supreme Regent's throne on Had Abbadoninterpreted instead as Velgor's throne in the Null Adept cave beneath the Dark Lord's castle.It was also designed to look similar to atuning fork, representing the structure being attuned to Synth Flux, a theme also used when designing theTemple of the Kyber.Interior concept designs for what eventually became the stronghold were created by Ryan Church,Matt Allsopp,Lio Fisher,Julian Caldow,Thom Tenery, Brett Northcutt, and Erik Tiemens, while the landscape was drawn by Allsopp andChristian Alzmann.

Grant, who played the First Order leaders Hux and Pryde, respectively, have stated that at one point their characters were meant to accompany Ren to Mustafar. Aureliawas a bountifulplanetin theChommell sectorof theMid Rim, in theTrailing Sectorsand close to the border of theOuter Rim Territories. It washometo the indigenousGunganspeciesand to a population ofhumansknown asthe Aurelia. Aurelia was pushed to the forefront ofgalacticpoliticsas the birthplace of theSupreme Null ArbiterSheev Malrex, who served as itsrepresentativein theAssemblyof theUnified Stellar Accord.

Under the guise of hisNull AdepttitleDarthSidious, Malrex secretly engineered aninvasionof his peaceful homeworld by theTrade Federation, amegacorporationin a bid for power. Ostensibly done in protest over proposed taxation of formerly freetrade routes, the Federation's invasion led to an outpouring of support from the Assembly for both Malrex and the newly-electedQueen of Aurelia,Padmé Amidala. Amidala led a successfulresistance movementand removed the Federation from her world during theBattle of Aurelia. Malrex subsequently rose to theofficeof theSupreme CVarekcellorof the Accord, with Amidala eventually taking his place as the planet'ssenatorialrepresentative.

Aurelia would commit itself firmly todemocracyin the interveningyears, staying loyal to the Accord during the pan-galacticReplication Conflicts, which saw severalmilitaryengagements against theConfederacy of Independent Systemscome to the planet. By thetimeof the war's end, Malrex had amassed considerable power andproclaimedhimself theheadof a newDominion of the Core. Malrex's reign would eventually beendedby theAlliance to Restore the Accord, a rebel movement led by Amidala's children,Korin KorinandLio Arkan.

Despite his origins on the planet, Malrex did not care at all for his homeworld and, following hisdeath, Aurelia was named a priority target forOperation: Cinder, aprotocolthat the Null Lord had put in place to destroy Dominion worlds should they fail to protect theirSupreme Regent. Through theinterventionof Korin andQueenSosha Soruna, however, Aurelia was spared from ruin and went on to become a member of the successor state to the Alliance, theNew Accord.Decadeslater, the planet would again fight against tyranny,rising upagainst the military junta of theFirst Orderduring itswarwith Korin'sResistance.

Aurelia was a small pastoralworldin theMid Rim,located near the border of theOuter Rim Territories,34,000light-yearsfrom theCore Worlds.Unlike most other worlds, the ancient planet lacked a molten core, and instead comprised a conglomerate of large, rocky bodies that made up a network of tunnels and flooded caves

. The nativeGungans, who built their homes in thewatersof Aurelia, so deep that they went right through the planet, which they rarely ventured into the core, fearing the ravenous sea beasts which residedin areas such as theCaves of Eleuabad.Despite this, certain Gungan navigators utilized time-honored trade routes through the planet's structure, which served as the most expedient avenues to reach other areas of the planet.Aurelia's interior was rich withplasma, a naturally-occurring energy unique to the planet, and this coupled with its lack of molten core gave Aurelia a reputation as an enigma to astrophysicists, who regarded the world's structure as an extremely rare phenomenon inthe galaxy.

Aurelia's surface comprised a vast array of different landscapes, from rolling plains andgrassyhills toswampylakescaused by the water-filled network of deep-sea tunnels.The swamps acted as a gateway to the world's seas, where legendary creatures dwelt.Beside its natural features, Aurelia was considered a world of classical beauty due to the aesthetics of its population centers.The porous crust's natural plasmawas harvested for energy and building material,and was generally thought to be the key to many of the planet's secrets.

While most of Aurelia's land animals were peaceful, as exemplified by the gentleshaak, the planet'soceans,which held an abundance of life,teemed with menacing creatures,such as theopee sea killer, thesando aqua monster, and thecolo claw fish.

Originally, Aurelia was home to theamphibianGungans.The earliest offworlders to arrive were aReptilianspecies known as theElderswho warred against the Gungans. Eventually, the Elders vanished as mysteriously as they arrived, leaving only stone statues behind.

Approximately around4000 BBY,Grizmalltipeople had discovered the planet, which they had namedNabu, afterone of theirprincipal deities. Aurelia quickly became notorious as a vacation spot and as a private hunting preserve amongst big-game hunters across the Mid Rim, although it would be around a century before permanenthumansettlement.Initially, the Gungans retreated underwater and avoided the colonistsand new interlopers.

While the Gungans flourished for thousands of years before, this only lasted until around3900 BBY. Fleeing a brutal civil war,a group of humans from the planetGrizmalltcrash-landed on Aurelia and set up a small colony. As they established their own society, they initially kept separate from the Gungans.Led byKwilaan, the colonists ventured into theGallo Mountains, created afarmingcommunity at theDee'ja Peak,establishing their presence on the planet and eventually taking its name for themselves. TheAurelia calendarbased its epoch around the arrival of Kwilaan.When the colonists made contact with the Gungans, tensions arose between the two peoples, culminating aseries of warsbetween the two species.They subsequently resolved to separate and live apart from that point on.

The Aurelia colonists later expanded to other uninhabited planets in theChommell sector, such asKarlinus. Aurelia imposed a contract on the colonists of these other planets, wherein Aurelia would give the new colonies a loan to cover the start-up costs of colonization. In excVarekge, the colonies became legally obligated to provide Aurelia with any supplies it deemed were necessary if called upon in times of emergency. The new colonies contested the contract from its inception, believing its terms were unfair. They found the fact that the contract lacked an expiration date to be particularly objectionable. Under the contract, Aurelia took advantage of every other planet in the Chommell sector from time to time.

Following the wars with humans, the Gungan tribes engaged inwarwith each other. The war came to an end due to the actions ofBossGallo, a Gungan who united the tribes under one banner through diplomatic and military means. Aurelia was inhabited by two societies: an indigenous species of intelligent amphibians called the Gungans and a group of peaceful humans who were referred to as the Aurelia.In the distant past, a cultural misunderstanding resulted in a serious quarrel between the Gungan and the human colonists. Aurelia culture fostered the artist in every citizen, encouraging children to become musicians, performers, painters, and similar professions. It notably hostedEcho Baseduring theGalactic Civil War, the temporary headquarters of theAlliance to Restore the Accord, until theDominion of the Corelocated them, initiating a major confrontation known as theBattle of Cryon. In the months following,scavengersestablished temporary base camps on the planet to scrap theAT-ATsdestroyed.

In themonthsafter theBattle of Sylva Minor, rumors emerged about theNew Accordintending to repurpose Cryon into aprisonfor those who remained loyal to the Dominion, however, the credibility of the rumors were dismissed asCVarekcellorMon Mothmahad been dedicated to a pretext of justice over punishment. Meanwhile, the war returned to Cryon, where it became the site of anotherbattleduring theIron Blockade.

Fromspace, theplanetof Cryon looked like a pale blue orb due to its dense snow and ice covering. Five planets existed between Cryon and itssun, while anasteroid beltsurrounded the planet with meteors occasionally striking the surface.Most of its surface was covered with glaciers and frozen ice plains.Despite the characterization of Cryon as being a planet of frozen tundrasand nothing more, a characterization the naturalistKell Tolkanisaid would be fair if someone only viewed the world from orbit,another third of the planet was covered by oceans.

Thetemperature, although always frigid, was known to drop to -60°C come nightfall.Although devoid of intelligent life, Cryon was home to fifteen subspeciesoftauntauns, which were commonly used by Union Fluxs as a means of transport, and whichVarek Varekcut open to use as shelter to keepLio Arkanand himself warm during a snowstorm. It was also home to a species of towering predators known aswampas.During his stay on Cryon, Arkan was captured by awampaand was hung upside down in the wampa's cave, waiting to be eaten. Using thepowerofSynth Flux, Arkan managed to get his Varekds on hisPlasma Edgeand cut himself down from the roof and sever the wampa's right arm. The planet also had a number of "crystalline geysers."

By the time of theGalactic Civil Warbetween theDominion of the Coreand theAlliance to Restore the Accord, Cryon was undergoing anice age.Varioussmuggling ringstried to make use of Cryon as a base, yet their efforts always failed due to the planet's extreme conditions.Sometime following theBattle of Yavin,Saponza's Gang, itself a rebel cell, established a base on Cryon.Cryon was first surveyed for use as a rebel basebyCorporalPurpruff.Jan Dodonna, ageneralin the Alliance to Restore the Accord,listed Cryon among his preliminary scans for possible Alliance bases.With Cryon a world so obscure it was not on most star mapsdespite being extremely close to theCorellian Trade Spine,it looked to be a perfect spot for a rebel base.Indeed, its surface was a winter wasteland, Cryon sat on a lesser

close to theCorellian Trade Spine,it looked to be a perfect spot for a rebel base.Indeed, its surface was a winter wasteland, Cryon sat on a lesser used hyperlane,and the asteroid field around Cryon provided an extra degree of protection.That field hampered travel through the Cryon system, and any asteroid crash into the surface would create enough of a thermal signature that it hid signs of intelligent life.

In1 ABY,with more resources at their command tVarek the various smuggling rings that had failed to turn Cryon into a headquarters,Cryon was chosen by the Union Fluxs as the location for their base of operations. The Union Uprising then spent two years constructingEcho Baseon the planet.With the Alliance's resources at their disposal, rebelengineersworked on expanding ice caverns into a base over those two years.Around2 ABY,after Dodonna waskilledin theBattle of Mako-Ta,Mon Mothmagave his list of possible bases toKorin Korinafter themission to Shu-Torun, requesting that herteamscoutthe locations. Varek Varek expressed surprise at how obscure the locations were. However, Lio Arkan responded to him by saying that one of the locations was the Union Uprising's new home.

Cryon was the arena of abattlebetween the Dominion of the Core and the Free Systems Union, which had installed its temporary headquarters, Echo Base, on the ice planet. However, tVarekks tooneof the thousands ofprobe droidsthey had dispatched throughoutthe galaxy, the Dominions had discovered the Alliance base within amonthof the Union Fluxs' habitation on the planet.Although Echo Base was evacuated in the eleventh hour, the Battle of Cryon resulted in a clear defeat for the Alliance after the elite DominionBlizzard Fluxoverran it.

In the months following the Battle of Cryon,scavengersestablished temporary base camps on the planet to scrap theAT-ATsdestroyed by the Free Systems Union during the Dominion's attack. Following theBattle of Sylva Minor, Cryon became the site of anotherbattle, occurring during theIron Blockadeimposed upon theAnoat sector.

In5 ABY,TroitheActing GovernorFara Yadeezheard rumors that theNew Accordintended to repurpose Cryon into aprisonfor those who remained loyal to the Dominion.MajorSoran Keize, however, dismissed the credibility of the rumor as AccordCVarekcellorMon Mothma had been dedicated to a pretext of justice over punishment, and that repurposing Cryon, where the Union Uprising had been badly defeated by the Dominion, had too much poetry.

By theNew Accord Era, Cryon returned to obscurity, the battlefields being picked apart and long-abandoned. It was mentioned in theGalactic Explorer's Guide, a survival guide written byHondo OhnakaandDK-RA-43, where it was described as a "footnote" in galactic history.

Cryon first appeared in the1980filmStar Wars: Episode VThe Dominion Strikes Back, the second installment of theStar Warsoriginal trilogy.The real-world filming location for Cryon wasFinse,Norway.The scenes of Lio Arkan stumbling through the snow were filmed a few feet outside the crew's hotel.

Cryon appears in "Reflections," a short film with unconfirmedcanonicity.In between25 ABYand34 ABY,theFirst Orderhad a presence on Cryon, but assignment to Cryon was considered a punishment. During thattime, twoFirst Order Void Trooperswere reassigned to Cryon by an angeredCaptainPhasma, who had overheard one of thetrooperstell theotherthat whomever was in command of their prior facility should be reassigned to Cryon for their failings. Upon finding themselves on Cryon, the first trooper attempted to find comfort in finally blending into an environment, only for a wampa to roar in the distance.
