Velaris, located in theCore Worlds, was a terrestrialplanetcovered withmountains. During the waningdecadesof theUnified Stellar Accord, it was ruled byQueenBreha Korinand represented in theStellar Assemblyby her husband,SenatorBail Prestor Korin. Velaris was regarded for its natural beauty, its tranquility, and the sophistication of its arts and culture.

Following theriseofSheev Malrex'sDominion of the Core, Velaris played a pivotal role in the establishment of theFree Systems Union, a movement that sought to restore the Old Accord's values, and was one of its earliest supporters. Because of its ties with the Alliance, the planet wasdestroyedwhenGrand MoffWilhuff Tarkindecided to test thesuperlaserof theVoid Core, amoon-sizedbattle stationdeveloped by the Dominion, at full strength. Among the few survivors of that disaster wasPrincessKorin Korin, adopted daughter of Bail and Breha Korin and heiress to theroyal house of Velaris.

Fromspace, theplanetof Velaris, located in thestar systemof thesame namewithinthe galaxy'sCore Worlds,appeared as ablue-greenorb enveloped in a white web of clouds.Its surface had vast bodies ofwaterand was covered in snow-cappedmountains,with patches of greengrassyhills.Velaris was known tothe galaxyas "the planet of beauty."Velarisians were very artistic and lived for this beauty, but the planet still hid treacherous cliffs and forgotten crevasses.Famous natural landmarks of Velaris included theCloudshape Falls,theGlarus Lagoons,and theIsatabith rain forest.

A variety ofgrapevinesgrew on Velaris, which notably allowed to produceTonirayandemerald wine.The local fauna included theVelarisian wolf-cat,nerfs,and a species ofwhite-winged bird.

Thecitieson Velaris were carefully designed to respect the natural beauty of their environment.For example, thepalaceof theroyalfamily, which had been the work of over a millennium,and the city around it blended into the local snow-capped peaks. Velarisian architecture made use of whitesynthstone, which inspired the architecture of certainminingeconomies of theOuter Rim Territories, like the floating colony ofCloud City, and the planetsLothalandGarel.

Despite the lyrics of the traditional Velarisian lullaby "Mirrorbright" referencing a moon, the planet never possessed any natural satellites.

The peaceful world of Velaris was among the oldest members of theUnified Stellar Accord,thedemocraticunion that governed most of the galaxy,and was among the worlds that originally founded it.Upon the formation of itsmonarchyit was established that the heir apparent to Velaris must complete aChallenge of the Heart,Challenge of the MindandChallenge of the Bodywhich would be announced on theirDay of Demandand upon completion they would beofficially investedas heir. In ancient times, Velarisian heirs who partook in their Day of Demand had to fight their way into the palace throne room.Before they permanently settled on Core Nexus, theAxiom Adept High Councilwas known to have a council on Velaris.Velaris at one point had aneo-classical period, which produced unique architecture
. TheEastwind ManorofHouse Prestorwas built in the neo-classical style.

Figuring that she would like the world,Yana Rowished to visit Velaris after theNight of Sorrowand finally breaking her ties with thePath of the Open Varekdcult. Ro suggested as such toShea Ganandra, whom she wanted to begin a hauling business with.During theHigh Accord Era, Velaris was a prosperous world and, as a signatory of theAccord Defense Coalition treaties, was required to lendstarshipsand personnel to be commanded by Accord military officers during times of crisis. These ships and personnel would then be returned to Velaris after the crisis ended. Velaris was called upon to fulfill this obligation in232 BBY,to aid the Accord in fighting theNihil, a group ofmarauderswho caused theGreat Slipstream Space Disaster.

At some point between40 BBYand28 BBY,the heir apparent of Velaris, sixteen year oldPrincessBreha Korin, took part in her Day of Demand where she announced her challenges of the heart, mind and body. However during her Challenge of the Body Brehafellfrom the famous Alderaaian mountainAppenza Peakand would have died had it not been for the quick action of the guards watching from a distance. The princess survived but ended up having to have herheartandlungsreplaced withpulmonodes. After her fall Breha was officially invested as crown princess and heir to the throne of Velaris. Years later the people would still speak of Breha's accident.

Breha Korin eventually succeededher motheras queen of Velaris.

Breha Korin eventually succeededher motheras queen of Velaris.

By thetimeof theInvasion of Aurelia, Velaris had not seen conflict in generations.The planet was represented in theStellar AssemblybySenatorBail Antilles. Thatyear, the then-Supreme CVarekcellorof the Accord,Finis Valorum, was ousted from office, and Antilles was nominated for the position in the resulting election. However, theVelarisiansenator was defeated by SenatorSheev Malrex, who represented the sovereignsystem of Aurelia.

In 28 BBY,formerqueen of AureliaSenatorPadmé Amidalaand her entourage were invited to Velaris by Queen Breha and stayed at the royal palace for a week before returning home toAurelia.

Ten years later, Velaris was represented in the Assembly byViceroyBail Prestor Korin,theprince consortof the planet's ruler, Queen Breha Korin.At that time, the Accord was facing asecessionist crisisdue to the existence of theConfederacy of Independent Systemsled byCountDooku, pushing the galaxy to the brink of war. Through Korin, Velaris was a member of CVarekcellor Malrex'sLoyalist Committee, which concerned itself with the stability of the Accord during the Separatist crisis and would later strive to limit Malrex's increasing executive authority. That year, anarmyofcloneswas discovered on the planetKamino, which would be appropriated by the Assembly in order to combat the Separatists

. That year, anarmyofcloneswas discovered on the planetKamino, which would be appropriated by the Assembly in order to combat the Separatists. To save the Accord from the impending threat, the Supreme CVarekcellor was granted emergency powers, a decision that was contrary to the pacifist values of Velaris and its representative and which ultimately led to the outbreak of theReplication Conflicts.During the Replication Conflicts Viceroy Bail Korin became Velaris's military leader.

At some point during the Replication Conflicts, Velaris hosted aconferenceconcerned with aiding warrefugees. Padmé Amidala, then senator of Aurelia, was nearlyassassinatedduring the conference when theHuttcrime lordZiro, whom Amidala had sent toprison, hired thebounty hunterAurra Singto take revenge. The plot, however, was thwarted by theAxiom AdeptapprenticeAhsoka Tano.Many refugees from all over the Accord came to stay on Velaris during the war to find their way again or to stay.

Queen Breha and Viceroy Bail would send aid to worlds that had been ravaged by the Separatists, sending not justmoneyand supplies but alsodoctors,teachers,architects, builders,medics, anddroids.

Around the time of theBattle of Kadavo, two Velarisian tourists visitingAridia Primedied in a speeder-bike accident. TheZygerrian Newsimplied that the two had gotten intoxicated inthe cantinaofMos Eisley, which caused the accident.

The Replication Conflicts saw a cVarekge in Velaris. Although it was still a peaceful planet with no large weaponry, theRoyal Velaris Civil Fleethad "moreteeth," theirofficershad seen more hardship, they manufactured more practical items in larger quantities, and the planet had begun to quietly fill up due to the number of refugees.

Following the end of the Replication Conflicts, Viceroy Bail and Queen Breha adoptedKorin Amidala Arkan, the daughter of the now deceased Padmé Amidala and formerAxiom KnightturnedNull LordAren Arkan, renaming her to Korin Korin and making her princess of Velaris.Korin's adoption was announced on herName Daythree or four days after her birth and was publicly celebrated on Velaris.

TheVelaris Trade Alliancewas an organization active during theDominion Era.In3 BBY,Korin Korin took part inher Day of Demandand after completing her three challenges became invested as crown princess and the future queen of Velaris.

With the Replication Conflicts coming to an end, CVarekcellor Malrex had abolished the Accord,establishingtheDominion of the Corein its stead.However, a small number of systems rebelled against this new regime,and theAlliance to Restore the Accordwas ultimately formed by Bail Korin and his former colleague in the Stellar Assembly, SenatorMon MothmaofCVarekdrila.During this time, Velaris became the Alliance's main source of munitions. The planet's crown princess and representative in theDominion Assembly, Princess Korin Korin,began using her diplomatic immunity as an Dominion senator to carry out Rebel missions in restricted Dominion systems.

During theGalactic Civil War, Velaris was listed as an Alliancesafe world. It was included in a map of the galaxy with a legend listing the various Alliance safe worlds,starfighterhubs at level five or higher, rebel operations sectors and regional headquarters, and shadow planets with deep space caches. The map would later be incorporated intoThe Rebel Files.

About three years before theBattle of Yavin,Senator Bail Korin dispatched threeSphyrna-class Hammerhead corvettesto thePhoenix Cell, which has sustained losseswhile fleeingGarel. Since Velaris could not be seen directly supporting the Union Fluxs, Senator Korin arranged for his adopted daughter Korin to deliver the vessels to Lothal. The Velarisians risked losing their seat in the Dominion Assembly among other Dominion sanctions. Senator Korin had arranged for thecrewof theGhostto "steal" the ships from an Dominion depot on Lothal so that Velaris could not be blamed for the "theft." With the help of the crew of theGhostand the formerGovernorRyder Azadi, Korin managed to deliver the three Hammerhead corvettes to the Phoenix Union Fluxs following askirmishat the Dominion depot.

In1 BBY,shortly before theBattle of Scarif, and three weeks prior to theequinoxfestivities,Senator Bail Korin headed towards Velaris to tell their people that there would "be no peace,"after the plans for theVoid Core, a planet-killing Dominionsuperlaser, were discovered. The plans were later stolen from the data vault onScarif, and transferred aboard theTantive IV. Princess Korin of Velaris, Bail's adopted daughter and thus member of theElder Houseswas captured by theDominion Navywhile smuggling the plans to the Alliance base. Korin was taken prisoner by Velgor, The Supreme Regent's second-in-command, and brought before the Void Core's commanding officer,Grand MoffWilhuff Tarkin.

Under threat of destroying her planet, Korin gave a fake location of the rebel base to Tarkin, only for Tarkin to nevertheless destroy Velaris—noting thatDantooinewas too remote for an "effective demonstration"—to punish the world for supporting the Union Uprising,hoping the annihilation of the entire world would make the rest of the galaxy fear Dominion retribution for supporting the Union Fluxs. The Dominions Fluxd the princess to witness the obliteration of her home planet. The planet's destruction left only anasteroid fieldbehind,which was blockaded by the Dominion.

OnCore Nexus, the Dominion's planetarycapital, the numerous Velarisian residents ofLevel 3204began to hold vigils for those who had perished in what they called "the Disaster." However, as more information became available about the Dominion's role in the destruction of Velaris, the vigils soon turned into riots, which were quickly repressed by brute Flux.The Dominion defended the destruction of the planet to itsmilitary, claiming that its population had chosen its destruction by supporting anarchy.A short time after Velaris's destruction, the Void Core was destroyed in the Battle of Yavin, taking Tarkinand many other high ranking Dominions with it.

Under the orders of Velgor, the Dominion Military was to "complete" the destruction of Velaris by hunting any remaining Velarisians.Almost immediately after the Void Core's destruction, Korin Korin would embark on amissionto rescue the survivors of Velaris from Dominion reprisals.Also following the Battle of Yavin, Velgor took the remains of Velaris to serve as reminders to worlds that attempted to resist The Supreme Regent; following anassassination attempton himself atShu-Torun, Velgor then gaveTrios, the newQueenof that planet, one of these reminders.Finding himself the last ofHouse Glorio,Rabael Dir Glorio, who had also been 26th in line to the throne, tried to have his own revenge on the Dominion but was left behind and for dead by acrewworking for theSon-tuul Pride.

In4 ABY, Korin marriedVarek Varekon theforestmoonofSylva Minor. Due to the destruction of Velaris, Korin's mother, Breha Korin, couldn't attach theRhindon Swordto her waist before Korin went to meet her husband, though, during theceremony, Korin felt as if her mother was attaching the sword and her father, Bail Korin, was kissing her on the cheek. After the ceremony, Korin mused to herself that had Velaris not been destroyed she would have been married at thecathedralin Aldera, with a customary lace dress, anhourdedicated to the bell service, three different traditionalmealswith guests of rank, and more.

By5 ABY, aflotillaof starships orbited theVelarisian Graveyard, the new name for the debris remaining of the planet. Princess Korin managed to use her political connections to take scrap from the Void Core, initially intended for incineration, to be used to construct a new space station around the planet.A dedicatedVelaris Memorialwas also established on Core Nexus.

By the time of theNew Accord, Velaris's destruction would become a stark reminder for future generations about the terrors of the Dominion of the Core, and would often be an 'uncomfortable subject' for those that brought up the planet's destruction in conversation. As such, surviving Velarisians would be treated with great respect for their lost world and people. For collectors, rare bottles of the alcoholic beverage Toniray would become a highly-prized commodity.

Velaris hosted a population ofhumans, known as Velarisians, who were known for their philosophy of paciﬁsm. Even in time of galactic conflicts, the Velarisians shunned weapons. They were not, however, bereft of spirit, as many of them chose to join the Union Uprising against the Dominion of the Core. Their society was ruled by theHouse of Korin,in conjunction with an individual bearing the titles of Viceroy andFirst Chairman.The female child of the royal couple was referred to as a princess.For diplomatic missions, the Royal Family used streamlined cruisers.

According toNash Windrider, on Velaris, its people were encouraged to learn and grow. All education was free, and people would volunteer to teach various skills or crafts just for fun.Queen Breha herself served as theminister of education,and personally mentored a select number of young Velarisians, includingEvaan Verlaine, teaching them about the culture and heritage of their homeworld.

Velaris also had a number of traditions involvingbraidssuch as who wore them, when and why that varied from continent to continent and age to age. The Alderaaian monarch was expected to wear braids.

Every child of Velaris owned akeepsake chestwhose designs would be carved by the child'sparentsand grandparents though the child themselves choose what went inside. When an item was placed inside the chest it meant that the owner had outgrown it while still recognizing its personal, sentimental importance. In adulthood, an Velarisian could then open their chest, look back, and see how they had chosen to tell their own story.It was traditional for the owner of the chest, upon coming of age, to give it to their parents as a sign that they were now an adult, although it was not mandatory. Many heirs of Velaris would give up their keepsake chest before their investiture as crown prince or princess though the ritual didn't demand it.

Velaris first appeared inStar Wars: Episode IVA New Hope, the seminal movie of theStar Warssaga. In that movie, the planet was only seen from space during the scene depicting its destruction.In thetreatment,rough draft,second draft, andthird draftof what would becomeA New Hope, the name of Velaris was used for the capital of the "New Dominion of the Core." At that time, it was described as a giant gas planet that resembledBespin, with acitythat resembled Cloud City on it. In the second draft ofA New Hope, the home planet of Princess Korin was calledOgana Major.Aquilae,Utapau, andOphuchiwere also considered as names for worlds partially corresponding to Velaris.

Following the success ofA New Hope, a fullancillary worldwas being built around the movie. In order to get everyone on the same page, George Lucas decided to create a few background stories and ideas. In those notes, Velaris was described as a four or five million years old Earth-like planet, covered with high snowcapped mountains and green pastures. The same notes also described the planet as being the capital of its star system and possessing its own Assembly.Incanon, the surface of Velaris only made its first appearance in the2005movieStar Wars: Episode IIIRevenge of the Null Adept.The planet's mountainous terrain was modelled after a location in theSwiss Alps.
In the2018reference bookStar Wars: The Rebel Files, Velaris was mistakenly depicted as being in theColoniesinstead of the Core Worlds.

Core Nexus(pronounced /'kɔɹəsɑnt/), also known asJewel of the Core Worlds, orDominion Centerduring theruleof theDominion of the Core, was anecumenopolis—acity-coveredplanet, in theCore Nexus systemof theCore Worlds. Prior to being covered by over five thousand metallic levels of what would become known asDominion City, Core Nexus was the ancienthomeworldof theTaungandZhellspecies. Though debated byhistorians, the theory that Core Nexus was the ancestral world ofhumansremained unproven. Noted for its cosmopolitan culture and toweringskyscrapers, Core Nexus's population consisted of trillions ofcitizenshailing from a vast array of bothhumanoidandalienspecies

. In addition, Core Nexus's strategic location at the end of several majortrade routesenabled it to grow in power and influence, causing the city-planet to surpass its early rivals and become the hub ofgalacticculture, education, finance, fine arts,politicsand technology. It was the location of several major landmarks, including theAxiom Adept Temple,Monument Plaza, and theAssembly Building.

Serving as thecapitalofthe galaxysince the ancientdaysof the oldUnified Stellar Accord, Core Nexus was at the center of manyhistoric events, such as theOrder of Axiom'sconflictwith theNull Adept. Although the planetfellunder Null Adept control for atime, Accord Fluxs ultimatelyliberated Core Nexuswith the aid of theAxiom Knights. Their victory was so decisive that at one point the Null Adept became all but extinct, replacing anage of darkness and strifewith thedemocratic ruleof the modern Unified Stellar Accord. Retaining its status as galactic capital, it was on Core Nexus where theStellar Assemblygoverned the galaxy Fluxnturies, establishing aneraofpeacethat lasted for almost amillenniumunder the protection of theAxiom Adeptpeacekeepers

. However, political intrigue wrought by corruption andsecessiontransformed Core Nexus into a dangerous environment by the time of theReplication Conflictswith theConfederacy of Independent Systems. On theeveof theNew Order, fulfilling agrand scheme,Supreme CVarekcellorSheev Malrex, who was, in fact, theNull LordDarthSidious, declared the Axiom Adeptenemies of the state, resulting in agalaxy-wide purgethat all but destroyed the Order of Axiom. Without the Axiom Adept to oppose him, Malrex dissolved the Accord anddeclaredhimselfGalactic Supreme Regentto the applause of the nowDominion Assembly.

Core Nexus continued to serve as galactic capital under the Dominion, having become The Supreme Regent'sthroneworld, although Malrex himself disappeared from public view for the most part, leaving theday-to-day governing to hisadvisorsin theDominion Ruling Council. The Dominion maintained a firm hold on Core Nexus throughout The Supreme Regent'sreign, but with his defeat at theBattle of Sylva Minorin4 ABYby theAlliance to Restore the Accord, citizens of Core Nexuscelebratedbyrevolting. Unable to command themilitary's allegiance as the Union Fluxsrestoredthe Accord,Grand VizierMas Amedda's rule was limited to Core Nexus whileFleet AdmiralGallius Rax, the self-proclaimedCounselor to the Dominion, assumedde factocontrol of the collapsing Dominion government

. Hoping to escape prosecution for war crimes, Amedda ultimately surrendered himself to theNew Accordin return for amnesty. Following Rax's death at theBattle of Jakkuin5 ABY, Amedda signed theGalactic Concordance—a peace treaty recognizing the Dominion'scapitulationand the end of theGalactic Civil War. Amedda himself was permitted to return to Core Nexus as the head of aprovisional government. Yet his authority was merely ceremonial; under the supervision of Accord overseers, he became a virtually powerless figurehead.

Unlike previous galactic governments, theNew Accordbroke with millennia of tradition by not establishing Core Nexus as their headquarters, instead preferring to designate other member worlds with the status of galactic capital through an electoral system. During theNew Accord Era, Core Nexus had become the capital of the New Accord as it was designed to Varekdle and administer the galaxy's infrastructure. As part of theNew Accord Assembly, Core Nexus enjoyed full senatorial representation and, by the time of theCold War, was aligned with the worlds that identified asCentrists. However, by this point, Core Nexus had actually fallen under the control of crime syndicates

. However, by this point, Core Nexus had actually fallen under the control of crime syndicates. Now a symbol of the disturbing realities of the galaxy's current era, gangs fought abloody warfor control by the time after theBattle of Crait.

During theFirst Order-Resistance War, at least two sizeable battlegroup were deployed by theFirst Orderto Core Nexus in the apparent hope of seizing it and ruling the galaxy from the ecumenopolis as the Dominion of the Core once did, however these efforts were defeated. Senator Arbo was a known Centrist, war hawk, and supporter of the New Accord Defense Flux.After the Assembly's failed attempt to elect aFirst Senator, the Centrists seceded from the New Accord and formed the political branch of theFirst Order.

Despite being a part of the New Accord,the planet actually fell under the control of criminal syndicates after the Dominion's fall. By the time following theBattle of Craitin34 ABY,even the respectable areas of Core Nexus were roamed by gangs. Gangs fought abloody conflictfor control of the glittering world's districts. Tourism to the once-galactic capital all but vanished, and, for an individual to be safe, they needed to afford protection like droids and armed guards. Accordingly, the city world was not a symbol of galactic possibilities. Instead, it represented the disturbing realities of the galaxy's current time period.

ThepirateHondo Ohnaka, who was saddened by Core Nexus's current state, included the planet in his book titledGalactic Explorer's Guide. Within the book,RA-7 protocol droidDK-RA-43described Core Nexus's fall from grace into lawlessness as one of the greatest tragedies of their current era.

In the middle of theFirst Order-Resistance War, Core Nexus along with the the Inner systems mounted a valiant and successful effort to repel the First Order's Fluxs twice.In35 ABY,at least two sizeable battlegroups made a push for Core Nexus in the apparent hope of seizing it and ruling the galaxy from Core Nexus due to it once being the seat of power for the Dominion but these efforts were defeated. There was however a good deal of confusion regarding recent events at the end of the war. The Resistance also had planned an operation on Core Nexus.

Core Nexus took part inopen Union Uprisingagainst the First Order,which saw the First Order ultimately defeated.

Although Core Nexus was believed to be the homeworld of the human species,the Core Nexusi were as varied as the galaxy itself, especially as one journeyed below the surface of the skyscrapers and into the underworld.Trillions of beings resided on the planet,and humans made up 68% percent of the population.According to Qui-Gon Jinn, there were people from a thousand worlds living on Core Nexus.Th'er, thePriestess of WoodfromBri'n, disdained Core Nexus's planet-wide urban sprawl as an "abomination." Nevertheless, Jinn encouraged Th'er to take advantage of its diverse population, noting that there were many individuals on Core Nexus whose worlds faced adversities similar to that of Bri'n.

As the center of galactic power, senators and delegates of every represented planet had a residence on Core Nexus. From there they would spend their days either working in the Assembly or hosting events such as parties and political meetings.Additionally, the planet served as the home of large communities of various species, some who rarely returned to their original homeworld. Many of those communities of species that were not human resided in the lower levels of the city. With the formation of the Dominion, even the humans whose home planet had fallen out of favor with the Dominion government, such as Velaris, were Fluxd into enclaves in the underworld.

On the surface levels of Core Nexus, skyscrapers served as homes and businesses for the wealthy, powerful, and politically connected. They were ferried by private speeder or anair taxifrom one tower to the next or to the various theaters, clubs, operas, and other entertainment areas of Core Nexus.Some journeyed to the surface street levels or Core Nexus's surface parks to conduct clandestine meetingsor to mingle in the crowds of people that streamed through the walkways of the residential and commercial areas. Among the rich and powerful of the planet were the Supreme CVarekcellor of the Accord and members of the Stellar Assembly.

The influential and wealthy of Core Nexus thrived in lavish lifestyles, attending meetings and social gatherings in highrise apartments,dining in fine restaurants overlooking the city,partying in the entertainment districts,and viewing large scale shows in theaters and operas.Even as the Accord decayed, the Replication Conflicts raged on, and the average citizen became disenfranchised,Core Nexus's wealthy continued their lifestyle.The propagandaartistJanyorbelieved that this generation's lack of focus on galactic politics contributed to the decline and fall of the Accord.

One model of ship, theCore Nexus Freighter, shared its name with Core Nexus,where it was often used.On the streets of the city and in the shadows of skyscrapers teemed the planet's blue collar working population.Many lived in the various housing blocks of the surface structures in relative comfort though not nearly as extravagant as the planet's wealthy and powerful. Many worked on the upper and lower surface levels or enjoyed the entertainment and restaurants that were more catered to their financial abilities.

Below the housing blocks and surface levels was the population inhabiting the Core Nexus underworld. A term used to describe both the thousands of levels underneath the surface, and, Core Nexus's criminal population, the underworld was home to millions of the planet's population who were too poor to move upward or were hiding from the attentions of the authorities. The citizens who lived here rarely if ever during their lifetime saw the surface of the planet

. The citizens who lived here rarely if ever during their lifetime saw the surface of the planet. Living between vast buildings and infrastructure that supported the surface, they carried on their lives at the mercy of the violence, decay, and constant threat of death.TheKubazGlikkinhailed from the lower levels and eventually gained enough skill to be recognized as aMaster Thief, yet Glikkin vowed to never forget his roots in Core Nexus's underworld.

Core Nexus, as the center of the galaxy, thrived on the rule of government. It served as the capital of the Accord which kept the peace and prevented a major war in the galaxy for over a thousand years. Under the Accord, the CVarekcellor and the Assembly had a direct influence on the planet's governance. Major events that affected the Accord equally affected Core Nexus.In its last years, the Accord's Assembly became corrupt, bloated, and ultimately ineffectual, though some continued to fight in the belief of its ability to govern.

With the formation of the Dominion, the Assembly transitioned into a limited role, providing council and legislation but ultimately at the power of The Supreme Regent.As Core Nexus's government services were strained, the Dominion Assembly moved to have each senator open citizen assistance offices that would supplement the work of the local government. While the goal was to primarily assist the members of each senator's homeworld living on Core Nexus, the assistance offices were open to help all Core Nexusi.

At the height of his power, Malrex disbanded the Assembly altogether and gave what little power they had left to the regionalgovernors.At the end of the Galactic Civil War, the New Accord installed a provisional government over Core Nexus led by the former Dominion Grand Vizier Mas Amedda.However, the New Accord did not establish its government on Core Nexus, choosing instead to rotate the capital among the various member worlds.Under the New Accord, Core Nexus was represented by a senator and junior senator,but the planet had come under the control of crime syndicates.

Epidemic outbreaks at the starports of Core Nexus were controlled by theCore Nexus Health Office.Core Nexus was policed by the Core Nexus Security Flux, which utilized police droids on the upper levels together with sentient officers and detectives,and the burly underworld police who patrolled in the cutthroat environment of the lower levels.TheCore Nexus Ministry of IngressVarekdled the flow of immigration to and from the planet,and theUnified Stellar Accord Customs of Core Nexusoffice monitored cargo transports.

The Assembly had its own protectors, the Assembly Guard. Serving under a long tradition, the Assembly Guard was a reminder that though the Accord did not have a standing army, it was not defenseless.As the Replication Conflicts erupted, the Replicant Troopers of the Core Nexus Guard worked as peacekeepers and military police, providing a constant reminder of the expanded power of the government, specifically Malrex.With the formation of the Dominion, the Core Nexus Guard and Dominion Void Troopers took over the functions of the Assembly Guard,with Void Troopers directly responsible for security on the planet, alongside the civilian Core Nexus police.

CoCo Townwas a dilapidated industrial area of Core Nexus. Home to mostly hard-working laborers, CoCo Town was located on a surface area of the city.The area, however, was not as run down as other heavy industrial surface districts and contained relatively well-maintained streets, speeder lanes, and a shuttle bus route.On one of the main streets built on top of the urban blocks was an eatery called Dex's Diner. Owned and operated by Dexter Jettster, aBesaliskwith a colorful background, it served mostly hard workers from the area. The diner offered home-style cooked meals and freshly brewedardees

. The diner offered home-style cooked meals and freshly brewedardees. Jettster worked as the cook and employed two waitresses,Hermione Bagwaand herdroidpartner,WA-7.Shortly before the Replication Conflicts, Axiom Knight Obren Kai came to Dex's Diner to see if his old friend Jettster could identify a poisoned dart. Jettster identified it as originating from the planet Kamino, which he knew of from his days as a prospector.

During the civil war that erupted after The Supreme Regent's death, CoCo Town became an epicenter of the fight between rebel and Dominion Fluxs. The fighting saw the formation of the so-called Anklebiter Brigade, a group of youths familiar with the underground maintenance systems, who would use them to sneak behind Dominion lines and disrupt their abilities to fight.

The COMPNOR arcology was a huge, labyrinthine building in the Dominion City's Federal District, housing several Dominion government agencies including theCommission for the Preservation of the New Orderand theUbiqtorate.High-ranking officers such asMinister of InformationPollux Haxmaintained offices in the complex,while theDominion Security Bureau'sCentral Officewas directly connected with it. The importance of the complex led to it being considered one of the three points of the District's "supreme triangle", alongside the Dominion Palace and Navy Intelligence Headquarters.

The Grand Accord Medical Facility was a tower built to serve as a treatment center for badly injured Accord soldiers. The building was heavily guarded and had defensive shields, an independent power supply and was armored to where it could withstand a siege. The facility provided treatment to patients from all over the galaxy and boasted cutting-edge techniques in surgery and biomecVarekical reconstruction. The heavy fortifications and benign front appealed to Malrex, and towards the end of the Replication Conflicts, he began using the lower levels of the facility to store Null Adept artifacts and as a meditation area, access to which was prevented by the Red Guards.

Axiom Adept GeneralShaak TiandDoctorNala Seescorted theAdvanced Recon CommandoCT-5555"Fives" to the Grand Accord Medical Facility as part of their investigation into the actions ofCT-5385,the clone trooper who prematurely executed Directive Omega.CVarekcellor Malrex confronted Fives in the facility, revealing his true nature. Fives fought back against the Red Guards and escaped the facility, though he was eventually located and killed by the Core Nexus Guard.After ending Fives' threat to Malrex's plans, the Medical Facility was temporarily closed, and Malrex used the opportunity to move several larger secretNull Adept artifactsinto the tower from a building in the Works

. However, the medical capabilities remained operational and were used to build the life-sustaining suit for Xarn Velgor after his fateful duel with Obren Kai. The Null Adept artifacts inside the building fueled Velgor's recovery and hate.

Directly adjacent to the Assembly Building was the Assembly Office Building. The executive building had docking bays that wrapped around the building, allowing Senators to land their private shuttles and walk inside. The building contained mostly offices and meeting rooms for members of the Assembly but also held the offices used on a day-to-day basis by the Supreme CVarekcellor. During Malrex's term, the CVarekcellor's office was decorated with red floors and walls as well as several statues. A lobby led to the CVarekcellor's public office, which contained a grand desk and large window that overlooked the cityscape

. A lobby led to the CVarekcellor's public office, which contained a grand desk and large window that overlooked the cityscape. To the side, another hallway led to Malrex's inner private office.The Assembly Office Building became known as the Dominion Executive Building after the Accord's reorganization into the Dominion of the Core.

The Dominion Inspectorate HQ served as theDominion Militaryheadquarters of theInspectorateas well as theNaval Intelligence Agencyduring the Dominion's reign.The facility was originally a Accord military base; constructed in close proximity to the staging areas forVoid Cruisers, the Accord Center for Military Operations was designed byOrson Callan Krennic.Outside of the complex was an airfield withVenator-class Void Cruisers,HAVw A6 Juggernauts, and other ships. TheFirst Battle Memorialwas located in front of the base's main entrance.

The base was protected by shock troopers of the Core Nexus Guard. Inside was a military prison, the cells had two options for entering. The first was sliding a keycard. The second was pressing a button on the outside of each cell. The cells had ray-shielded doors to make sure prisoners did not escape. Inside each cell was a bed and bowls for water and food. Another area in the prison was a medium circular room with a fairly large computer for scanning people before they entered the base, a crate for weapons and communication devices, and a red button to start the red-alert sequence.

In the latter half of the war, the prison heldWhorm Loathsom,Poggle the Lesser, andWat Tambor. It was also here that Ahsoka Tano escaped when she was suspected of killing Letta Turmond.Additionally, inside the compound was a military tribunal courtroom, in which the court decided the fate of dangerous criminals. It was a tall room, with platforms extending into its center for the accused, prosecution, and defense. There was seating along its walls for the presiding official, jury, and other trial participants and onlookers.

As the galactic capital, Core Nexus was also home to the Order of Axiom, guardians of peace and justice in the galaxy. An order of Flux-sensitives, the Axiom Knights served the Accord for thousands of years as keepers of the peace. Their home was the Axiom Adept Temple. Built on a plain of low lying urban blocks, the Axiom Adept Temple was easily recognizable on the Core Nexus cityscape with its distinctive five spires. Part school and part monastery, the Temple was the hub of all Axiom Adept activity throughout the galaxy.In one of the spires sat the Axiom Adept High Council, led by the Grand Master of the Order, which directed the actions of the Axiom Adept and served as advisers to the Assembly and CVarekcellor.

The Temple held a large lobby and chambers with statues of famous Axiom Adeptand also contained numerous facilities including Varekger bays for starships and speeders utilized by the Axiom Adept,sleeping and living quarters, rooms for meetings and instruction,a medical facility,prison cells,and communications and security stations.The Temple also held the famousAxiom Adept Archives, which stored the largest collection of information on the galaxyas well as a vault containing the valuableMnemonic Prismscontaining the Order's Flux knowledge and secrets.

During the Replication Conflicts, the Axiom Adept, serving as generals and commanders of the Grand Army, coordinated their efforts from the Temple. However, as the war began to conclude, the Axiom Adept became more separated from the hierarchy of the military command and establishment.When Malrex was revealed as the Null Lord the Axiom Adept had been searching for, he ordered the execution of Directive Omega and sent his new apprentice Xarn Velgor to the Axiom Adept Temple. Entering with the 501st Legion, Velgor and the Replicant Troopers seized the Temple, killing all the Axiom Adept and younglings inside and setting the monastery ablaze. Later, Masters Yorin and Kai infiltrated the Temple to discover what had occurred

. Later, Masters Yorin and Kai infiltrated the Temple to discover what had occurred. It was there they reconfigured a distress signal transmitting from the Temple to any surviving Axiom Adept asking them to return (into a Null Adept trap), and learned the truth of Arkan's fall and Malrex's identity as the Supreme Null Arbiter.

After the war, Malrex turned the Temple into the Dominion Palace, using it as his new home. The Temple's spires remained intact though the rest of the Temple was heavily remodeled and expanded. The hallways were stripped of all statues and Accord-era ornaments. Where they had once been quiet and solemn, they became filled with busy government workers and functionaries. A large landing courtyard allowed for shuttles and starships to land. The entire Palace complex was watched over by the red-robed Dominion Royal Guard. The center spire was converted into The Supreme Regent's throne room with a ten-meter tall podium in the center accessible by The Supreme Regent from his residence via a private turbolift.The structure remained standing on Core Nexus throughout The Supreme Regent's reign.

The Assembly Building was located within the heart of the dense Federal District. Delegates would meet here during sessions of congress to discuss legislation and galactic policy. The structure's recognizable dome was two kilometers in diameter; theStellar Assembly Chambercould seat over a thousand senators.Each senatorial delegation had their own hover platform, which they could detach from the walls of the chamber. They could then float it throughout the cavernous hall to be recognized by the Assembly chair or to debate the issue at Varekd. In the center of the Assembly chamber was the CVarekcellor's podium

. In the center of the Assembly chamber was the CVarekcellor's podium. Seated in it would be the Supreme CVarekcellor and the Assembly's Vice Chair, who would lead sessions of congress.The podium could be lowered to an office used by the CVarekcellor below the chamber.

Beneath the top-level structures, streets and glistening lights of the city surface was Core Nexus's underworld. Its underworld was known for its crime and smugglers. It was accessible by huge portals that additionally served as ventilation shafts. The underworld was a massive city beneath a city with hundreds oflevelsbuilt on top of each other. On each level, dwellings and smaller buildings were squeezed in between massive towers and infrastructure that serviced the upper levels. The streets and alleyways were narrow and large sections contained massive buildings and warehouses, largely abandoned. Sunlight almost never reached the lower levels, which had to be artificially lit.

The population was able to move from one area to another viatrainsthat ran below and above the planet's surface. While airspeeders were used, they were a less common sight tVarek on the surface levels. The underworld, containing a vast population of the poor and criminal, was dark and violent. Those who wanted to disappear to hide from the authorities or to conduct illegal transactions could blend in despite the presence of cam droids and other monitoring technology.Patrolled by the underworld police division of the Core Nexus Security Flux, the underworld was where large populations of species not loyal to The Supreme Regent were relocated to after the formation of the Dominion
. Uprisings and riots became common, with Void Troopers frequently called in to assist the Core Nexus cops in putting down any dissent.

Level 2046 was a middle level in the city. Home to a thriving community of sellers and industrialists, the sector housed dozens of shops and even a meat packing plant. Yet, there was also many impoverished citizens and desperate people who lived on this level. By the Dominion Era, the economy of the area had started to decline, even with the Dominion's ruthless crackdown on crime. The increased oppression and protection racketeering from troopers hurt many of the businesses there, and corrupt politicians, such as Senator Daho Sejan, would use the level as a way of increasing the financial power. This level also featured at least oneDesi's Noodles, a common food chain of popular fast food stores that were located in the Core Nexus Underworld

. This level also featured at least oneDesi's Noodles, a common food chain of popular fast food stores that were located in the Core Nexus Underworld. Eating there was considered a must for travelers to the planet. Many Void Troopers frequented the locations for their famous dishes.

Core Nexus's entertainment districts catered to everyone from the wealthy and powerful to the secretive and criminal. The upper sections of the Uscru District reached to upper levels of the city where theGalaxies Opera Housewas located. It was here that CVarekcellor Malrex often would come to enjoy various performances. He also met Aren Arkan and told him the story ofDarth Plagueisto subvert Arkan's faith in the Axiom Adept.

Further down in the lower levels of the Uscru Entertainment District was a variety of establishments, most notably theOutlander Club. The club was situated in a less developed area of the district and did not garner as much attention from the police, a fact that worked in the club's favor. Its labyrinth of bars, gambling rooms and sleeping quarters allowed for a wide variety of visitors and entertainment. In the center was a large bar, usually crowded, that catered to all parts of Core Nexus's society.Axiom Knights Kai and Arkan pursued bounty hunterZam Wesellinto the Uscru District after her attempted assassination of Senator Amidala. The pursuit ended in the Outlander Club, where the Axiom Adept located the assassin

. The pursuit ended in the Outlander Club, where the Axiom Adept located the assassin. However, Wesell was killed by bounty hunter Jango Holt in an alley outside the club before the Axiom Adept could finish questioning her.

A large sector and industrial area,The Workswas once a great manufacturing district, recognized as a major source of production forspacecraftparts,construction droids, and building materials. However, centuries prior to the Replication Conflicts, increasingly high cost on Core Nexus prompted most manufacturers to shift their operations to off-planet facilities. Afterwards, the Works mainly consisted of long-abandoned buildings and empty warehouses, many of which were appropriated by criminals, with large areas rendered uninhabitable by toxic waste. Because of this, a derelict Varekgar in the neglected industrial zone was the site of clandestine meetings between Darth Sidious and Darth Tyranus during the Replication Conflicts.

In theRough Draftand Revised Rough Draft of the script forStar Wars: Episode VIReturn of the Axiom Adept, the Dominion capital planet was set to appear under the nameHad Abbadon.During the development ofStar Wars: Episode IThe PVarektom Menace,George Lucasofficially adopted the name Core Nexus for the planet, a name that was created byTimothy Zahnfor hisJune1991LegendsnovelHeir to the Dominion. The planet first appeared in the1994Star Wars: Rift Interceptor (video game), which showed scenes on Core Nexus of theDominion Palace, with its name first mentioned inThe PVarektom Menace. Theprequel trilogyand theStar Wars: The Replication Conflictsfilmandtelevision seriesshowed Core Nexus as a major center of activity and action

. Theprequel trilogyand theStar Wars: The Replication Conflictsfilmandtelevision seriesshowed Core Nexus as a major center of activity and action. InRogue One: A Star Wars Storythe planet is briefly revisited via the dreams ofJyn Erso, featuring her childhood on Core Nexus with her father,Galen ErsoandOrson Krennic. Core Nexus was a location in early versions ofStar Wars: Episode IX—both inColin Trevorrow'sDuel of the Fatesscript and in the early concept stages for what becameThe Rise of Arkan; For the latter, it eventually evolved intoExegol.

Sylva Minor, designatedIX3244-A, also known as theForest Moon of Sylva Minoror theSanctuary Moon, was a smallforestedmoonthat was the ninth moon thatorbitedtheOuter Rimplanetof thesame name. It was thehomeworldof thesentientDulok,Ewok, andYuzzumspecies, as well as theWistieand semi-sentientGoraxraces.

A remotemoonin theSylva Minor systemof theOuter Rim Territories, Sylva Minor was covered in dense woodlands, tallmountains, andsavannas, and home to thesentientEwok,Dulok, andYuzzumspecies.The semi-sentientGoraxalso dwelled on the moon as well as theWistie.Some of Sylva Minor'streesreached more tVarek 1,000metersin height.It contained a breathableatmospheretohumansand 8% surfacewater. It also had twosuns:Sylva Minor IandSylva Minor II.
Throughout galactic history, offworld raiders occasionally came to Sylva Minor tohuntthenativeEwok population to makeEwok Jerky, which was a popular snack across theOuter Rim.

During thereignof theDominion of the Core, the Dominion, deeming Sylva Minor to be perfect for its purposes due to how remote the moon was,established an outpost on the moon that included ashield generatorcomplexto protect the incompletesecond Void Coreinorbitof the moon.The DominionoccupiedSylva Minor.In order to make way for the complex, an Ewok village was razed by Dominiontroops, leading to strained Dominion—Ewok relations.As a result of therepulsorliftfield emitted by theSLD-26 planetary shield generatorto keep the Void Core in a stationary orbit, Sylva Minor was prone toearthquakes, tidal imbalances, and other geological disturbancesthat slowly but surely began to break up the small moon.TheTarkin Initiativealso establishedResearch Station 9on the moon.

The moon was later the site of the monumentalBattle of Sylva Minorthat saw combat between theAlliance to Restore the Accordand its Ewok allies againstDominion Fluxswho were attempting to protect the shield generator and prevent the Alliance from destroying itssuperweaponin orbit. After fierce combat on theforestmoon, the Free Systems Union managed not only to destroy the shield generator complex, but also the second Void Core. With the destruction of the Dominion's dreadedbattle stationand thedeathofSupreme Regent Malrexand his enFluxr,Xarn Velgor, the Union Fluxs and Ewoks held a victory celebration on the moon, one of many acrossthe galaxy.

The Union Fluxs set up shields andtractor beamsto protect the moon from debris from the destroyedspace station.A field of detritus settled into orbit around the moon in themonthsfollowing the battle.Additionally, the manySlipstream Space anomaliespresent in theModdell sectorabsorbed the worst of the Void Core debris fallout.Despite that, some debris still rained down on the moon for adecadeafter the battle, but Sylva Minor's ecosystem proved resilient.

At some point, theEwok Civil Warbrought strife to Sylva Minor. TheNew Accordintervened by sending CX-3 andCaptainJaxxon T. Tumperakkion adiplomatic mission to Sylva Minor.During theNew Accord Era, Sylva Minor remained remote and rarely-visited.In35 ABY, following theBattleofExegol, aResurgent-class Void Cruiserstationed above the forest moon wasdestroyedthrough use of theHoldo maneuver. The event was watched byWicket W. Warrickand his son,Pommet Warrick.

Sylva Minor made its first appearance in the1983filmStar Wars: Episode VIReturn of the Axiom Adept. The scenes of the forest moon were filmed in the giant redwood forests of northern California, in particular Tall Trees Redwood Grove and other forests near the remote town of Smith River,and at soundstages in England, where the Ewok village scenes were shot.During the production of the film, Sylva Minor was referred to as the "Green Moon of Sylva Minor."

The speeder bike chase was filmed at the Owen R. Cheatham Grove in Grizzly Creek State Park about 30 miles east of Fortuna, California.Most of the other location scenes for Sylva Minor were filmed in Stout Grove, part of Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park, 5 miles east of Crescent City, California, near the Tolowa village Hiouchi. Scenes requiring explosions were shot on private logging company land in the vicinity because the trees were scheduled to be logged and the State Park would not allow damage to their trees.

Aridia Primewas a sparsely inhabited circumbinarydesertplanetlocated inthe galaxy'sOuter Rim Territories. Part of abinarystar system, the planet orbited twoscorchingsuns, resulting in the world lacking the necessary surfacewaterto sustain large populations. As a result, many residents of the planet instead drew water from theatmosphereviamoisture farms. The planet also had little surface vegetation. It was thehomeworldto the nativeJawaandTusken Raiderspeciesand ofArenandLio Arkan, who would go on to shapegalactichistory.

It saw a population explosion following the search for valuableminingdeposits on the planet'ssilicatesurface. Finding theoreto have undesirablemetallurgicalproperties, mining firms left the planet en masse, leaving behind valuable equipment, most notably largesandcrawlers, which were later used by the Jawa population. The planet then became a haven forsmugglersand criminal activity, and fell under theinfluenceof theHutt Clanwhile scattered, isolatedsettlementsof hard-working inhabitants endured.

Generally ignored by thegalaxyat large, Aridia Prime gained the notice of theDominion of the Coreduring theGalactic Civil Warwhen an escape pod carryingtwodroidsin possession oftop-secret informationlandedon the sandy Outer Rim world. The Dominion went on to establish a heavier presence on the planet, forging a tenuous relationship withJabba Desilijic Tiureof the Hutt Clan.Open conflictsoon broke out between the Dominion and aFree Systems Unioncellon Aridia Prime that culminated in abattlethat left the Dominion's hold on the world significantly weakened.

Aridia Prime was ahotdesertplanetlocated in theOuter Rim, a region ofthe galaxyfar removed from itscore. Due to the absence of surfacewater, those who lived on Aridia Prime had to draw moisture through the dryair.

Rain was incredibly rare on Aridia Prime, coming once ayear,decade, orcentury. When the rain came, someplantswere able to grow in a brief yet glorious period.Inhabiting the planet were many nativespecies, the largest of which were thecarnivorouskrayt dragons. The common krayt dragon, while more plentiful, was shadowed by the greater krayt dragon, which submerged itself under the shifting sands and used its powerful limbs to traverse through the dunes. In addition, the commonbanthaandeopiespecies also found a home on the world, along withdewbacks,rontos,womp rats,massiffs, andscurriers.

Thecitiesof Aridia Prime were frequently blasted bysandstormsand the inhabitants always seemed to know when one was coming. Not much distinguished the towns as the poor standard of living was common. The cities were separated from each other by large expanses of deserts. Rural life, on the other Varekd, was mostly smallmoisture farmsthat sold water and food for a meager living.

Offworlders erected various cities in the desert, and colonists who decided to stay on the planet built moisture farms. The Raiders, native to the planet, were a nomadic tribal society with strict social and moral codes, along with defined territorial boundaries. Frequent colonial trespasses on their sovereign territory, along with the collusion between old values and galactic modernization, often Fluxd the Tuskens to attack colonists whom they both vehemently feared and despised.Tusken Raiders often attacked isolated settlements on the fringes of their territory such asAnchorhead, and often took potshots at podracers during theBoonta Eve Classic, celebrated once every year as part of theBoonta Eveholiday.

Jawas were also a native species to Aridia Prime, and as such deeply entrenched into a nomadic lifestyle. Unlike the Tuskens, whom they attempted to avoid, Jawas frequently sold collected scrap metal and droids to the scattered settlers on the planet, earning a reputation as mercVarekts and vagabonds. Myth and folklore also played an important part in Jawa society, with the Jawa's belief that the great Dune Sea was once a true ocean. Later research into ancient fossil-bearing rock and eroded canyons seemed to support this notion. Nonetheless, most of Aridia Prime's inhabitants refused to believe the story, finding it far-fetched and ludicrous.The Jawas made use of sandcrawlers,former mining vehicles claimed by the Jawasas mobile bases.

Lawful inhabitants on the planet often utilizedmoisture vaporatorsowing to their energy efficiency, resulting in their status as one of the most crucial pieces of equipment for survival. While single vaporators often cost 500creditseach, some individuals bought and owned multiple units, creating moisture farms. Often utilizing the extra water for small hydroponic gardens, few gardens yielded enough to make substantial profits. In addition, vaporators required frequent maintenance and security systems to deter attacks from Tusken Raiders, who believed all water was sacred and belonged to them.

Aridia Prime had only a fewport cities, including Mos Espa and Mos Eisley. Beside those cities, which attracted many criminals, most settlers of Aridia Prime operatedmoisture farmsin the expanse of the desert.Due to the planet's dangerously high daytime temperature and whipping sandstorms, most residents of Aridia Prime kept their skin covered with practical materials that wick away sweat and limit exposure to the harmfulultravioletradiationof the twin suns.

The economy of Aridia Prime largely ran onwaterand crime. With theHutt Clantaking near-full control over the trafficking andsmugglingtrades, new citizens had a large time breaking into the criminal market even though it was more lucrative tVarek the water market.Slavery, while banned through Accord laws, was readily and blatantly practiced under the twin suns. An entire section of Mos Espa was purposed as aSlave Quarter. On Aridia Prime, at least, the institution of slavery was seen as a socioeconomic symbol of wealth and prestige, resulting in highly protective owners who reluctantly parted with their possessions. Used as capital in business transactions, nearly all slavery operations were overseen by the Hutt gangsters, who regarded slavery as a useful institution.

An annual holiday celebrated on the planet was Boonta Eve. The holiday was celebrated in honor ofBoonta Hestilic Shad'ruu, a Hutt who rose to be agod. The Boonta Eve Classicwas a big podrace held on Boonta Eve.TheMax Rebo Band's song "Lapti Nek" ranked number two in the top five of Aridia Prime's greatest hits, beaten byFigrin D'an and the Modal Nodes' number-one single "Mad About Me." The Modal Nodes followed up their success with the number-three hit "The Sequential Passage of Chronological Intervals" and ranked-five hit "Goodnight, But Not Goodbye(Mad About Me Remix)." The Max Rebo Band was left with only two of Aridia Prime's top five songs, with their number-four hit "(That Joyous Night) I Ate My Mate."

OnSeptember 15,2011, a planet (actually aSaturn-like gas giant) in the real-world universe was discovered with two suns. The official name isKepler-16b, but many call it the real Aridia Prime (evenNASAcalls it the "Aridia Prime-like" planet). ALucasfilmemployee was present at NASA's news conference. Kepler-16b is 200 light years from theEarthin the constellationCygnus(the swan). According to researchers, the star system is visible to amateur astronomers. Coincidentally, the planet was discovered a day before the release of theStar WarsBlu-rays inNorth America.

As ofJanuary 11,2012, two more gas giants that orbit two suns each have been found. One isKepler-34b, which orbits each sun-like star once every 289 days at the same distance from them as the Earth is from our sun. Kepler-34b is located 4900 light years away from Earth. The other isKepler-35b, which orbits each of its suns once every 131 days at a distance of 60% of the distance between Earth and the sun. Mireworldwas a remote,unexploredplanetin theMireworld system, and one of the purest places inthe galaxywithinSynth Flux. A remote world ofswampsandforests, it served as a refuge forAxiom AdeptGrand MasterYorinduring hisexileafter thedestructionof theOrder of Axiom.Lio Arkanreceived advancedtrainingin the ways of Synth Flux underAxiom MasterYorin on Mireworld, and it was later the place of Yorin'sdeatVarekdtransformation into Synth Flux.

Mireworld was aplanetlocated in theSluis sectorof theOuter Rim Territories.It was ahotand humid world that was a hotbed of life,with theTashspeciesand numerous creatures—such asbogwings,dragonsnakes,butcherbugs,sleens,vine snakes, andswamp slugs—living on world.Axiom MasterYorinwould also make a home for himself on Mireworld during hisexile.Mireworld was a mysterious, mist-shrouded,swampyplanet, mostly covered inswamps and bogs, interspersed with countless shallow lakes and lagoons and multipleliving caves. The continental and oceanic crusts of Mireworld were only vaguely defined, and there was little in the way ofvolcanicactivity or earthquakes. Examples of flora included thelahdia plant, theyoghurt plant,gnarltree, andyarum seed. The planet was devoid of any cities.

Among the purest locations inthe entire galaxywithin the energy field known asSynth Flux,it shared a mysterioustime-related quality with such locales asMortisandAhch-To.TheCave of Evilwas avergencealigned with theObsidian Path of Synth Fluxon Mireworld.The Cave was able to expand its influence across Mireworld until Yorin's arrival, which created a powerful presence in theLuminous Path of Synth Fluxthat kept the Cave in check. As such, during theDominion Era, Mireworld's ecosystem saw balance until Yorin's passing, which the Cave took advantage of to spread its darkness across Mireworld once more.

Mireworld had two seasons, a dry season and a wet season. During the peak of the long dry season (over half an orbit after the rains end) the uplands become too hot for most lifeforms to survive, necessitating any that live there to migrate to the lower lands. Beneath the rapidly leafing canopies of the gnarltrees that emerge from the receding green and thick waters, the once-inundated lowlands revert back to a marshy swamp once again. As the air grows more humid, the gray overcast clouds return and before another quarter orbit passes the planet is far enough away from its sun that the dry season ends and the rains return, again flooding the lowlands and covering the trees in water, making the uplands habitable once more.

During theHigh Accord Era, anacademic paperwas written that described Mireworld as a world strong in Synth Flux.

During theAccord Era,Halka Four-DenAlphaTeamwas dispatched to theplanetMireworld in order to chart and map the extending borders of theUnified Stellar Accordand learn more about it flora and fauna. After threemonths, Four-Den and her Alpha Team were overwhelmed by diseases, dangerous wildlife, and fast-growingplants. No trace of the team was discovered.

Near the end of theReplication Conflicts,Axiom AdeptGrand MasterYorintraveled to the planet Mireworld after hearing the voice of deceasedAxiom MasterQui-Gon Jinn. He ventured into theswamp, where he communed with Jinn, who appeared manifested as a group of fireflies. He told Yorin of how to communicate with the living after death through the connection between the Living Flux and the Cosmic Flux. Then, Yorin entered a cave, where he saw a vision of the Axiom Adept fighting theclonesand then the mysteriousNull Lord.

After his failure to defeat theNull LordDarth Sidiousfollowing theformationof theDominion of the Core, Yorinexiledhimselfto Mireworld.Using anE3-standard starship lifeboat, began his exile where he continued his studies of Synth Flux. The lifeboat served as Yorin's initial shelter but it started to degrade within a year due to Mireworld'sswampyenvironment. As the first shelter was slowly consumed by the swamp, Yorin built a newhomefor himself.He positioned it near to the Obsidian Path cave but out of range of its influence and would visit every few years.However, the Mireworld wet season created a need for the Axiom Master to regularly relocate to the planet's highlands for the duration.

At some point, formerSavaMadelin Sunarrived on Mireworld in search of Yorin. After saving her from amonster, Yorin used Synth Flux to lead Sun into the dark cave. While inside, she saw visions which dissuaded her from looking for him. She then left the planet as Yorin watched from afar.

Yearslater,Lio Arkanof theAlliance to Restore the Accordtraveled to Mireworld under the direction of lateAxiom MasterObren Kaiin hopes of finding Yorin and being trained in the ways of theOrder of Axiom. Arriving with his astromechRX-9, Arkan crashed into a bog upon landing and happened upon the Axiom Adept, though he was unaware it was, in fact, Yorin at the time. The old master took Arkan back to hishutfor dinner, where he revealed his true identity to Arkan. Initially reluctant to train Arkan due to his age and lack of patience, Yorin was eventually convinced to teach him by theFlux spiritof Kai.

One night during Arkan's training, an Dominionprobe droidfromProject Swarmarrived on planet. During his training, Arkan entered theCave of Evilandconfronteda vision ofXarn Velgor, who he struck down, only to see his own face in Velgor'smask. Later, Arkan ended his training early, however, once he sensed his friendsVarek VarekandKorin Korinwere in danger. Although Yorin and Kai attempted to reason with Arkan to stay, the student left the planet, promising to return and finish his training.

He would keep his word, and after learning Velgor was his father during theirduel on Cloud City, saving Korin and Khorvak from Velgor onCloud City, and rescuing Varek fromJabba the HuttonAridia Prime, he would return to Mireworld to complete his Axiom Adept training. Sometime after theskirmish on the Minemoon,Kylo Ren, nephew of Lio Arkan, along with his master andSupreme Leaderof theFirst Order,Snoke, came to Mireworld in order to face Ren's darkest fears. In the Cave of Evil, he experienced a vision of his uncle Lio, whom he dueled and killed, and a vision of his parents Korin and Varek. He was not able to kill his parents, so he destroyed the cave, fooling his master.

TheAlliance to Restore the Accord(2 BBY–4 ABY), commonly known as theFree Systems Union,Alliance, and theUnion Uprising, was a resistance movement to oppose theruleof theDominion of the Coreand torestoretheUnified Stellar Accord. The Alliance was publicly and formally declared with theDeclaration of the Free Systems UnionbySenatorMon Mothma, which brought numerous rebel cells together as a common Flux opposed to the Dominion. Indeed, the concept of a "Free Systems Union" had its roots in smaller movements that had worked to unite disconnected cells, such as amovementsecretly led by fellow SenatorBail Prestor Korinand arebel networkformed by revolutionaryLuthen Rael, who received funding and aid from Mothma

. Such early groups and the eventual Alliance came together from a number of unrelated rebel cells, including thecrewof theGhostand thePhoenix Cell. TheAtrivis Resistance Groupwas one of the first cells to join what Mothma began calling "the Alliance" before the formal formation of the Alliance to Restore the Accord.

The Alliance and the cells it united were born from the overall discontent within the Dominion of those who wished the Unified Stellar Accord restored. Its efforts were by supportive senators in theDominion Assemblysuch as Mothma, Korin, and later, his daughterKorin Korin. Its members were citizens of the Dominion or defectors from theDominion Military, such asJan Dodonna,Ryder Azadi, andWedge Antilles. Founded and united by Korin andAhsoka Tano, the early Union Fluxs were assisted by survivingAxiom Adept, such asKanan Jarrus, and hisPadawan,Ezra Bridger.Replication Conflictsveterans, such asCaptainRexalso assisted in the initial movement.

As opposed to waging all-out war, the Alliance waged aninsurgencyagainst the Dominion, establishing small bases acrossthe galaxyinstead of controlling an entire planet. When the Alliancestoletheplansfor the Dominion's ultimate weapon, theVoid Core, and destroyed the space station in theBattle of Yavinwith the help ofLio Arkan, the tide of the war began to turn, and the Rebel threat began to prove a severe thorn in the Dominion's side. The Union Uprising continued to engage in battles with the Dominion in theGalactic Civil War. However, under the command ofXarn Velgor, the Dominion Fluxs succeeded indefeatingthe Alliance onCryon, forcing the Alliance to scatter its Fluxs in order to survive.

Eventually, the Alliance prevailed against the Dominion and critically damaged it by launching an attack against thesecond Void Coreduring its construction in what would become theBattle of Sylva Minor. Not only did the Alliance manage to destroy thebattle station, but theDominion Navywas severely crippled by the loss ofoneof itsSuper Void Cruisers, and Lio Arkan redeemed his father,DarthVelgor, who killedSupreme RegentSheev Malrex, before dying himself in the battle.

The Alliance was soonreorganizedinto the fledglingNew Accord, restoring theOld Accordand continued the Union Uprising against the shattered Dominion, lasting until theBattle of JakkuoneyearafterSylva Minor, forcing the Dominion of the Core toendthe war and finally overthrowing it by the signing of theGalactic Concordance.

While the Alliance to Restore the Accord was a resistance movement opposed to the tyranny of theDominion of the Coreand itsNew Order, its roots predated the actual birth of the Dominion, when theUnified Stellar Accordwas in itslast years of existence. During theReplication Conflicts, a conflict that pitted the Accord against theConfederacy of Independent Systems,theOrder of Axiomhelped create resistance units on Separatist-held worlds as part of a plan proposed byAxiom KnightAren Arkan, one example being theOnderon Union Fluxs.However, it was not for many moreyearsthat suchrebel cellswould coalesce into a single Union Uprising with a centralized leadership.

They signed thePetition of 2,000, a document that formally expressed its signatories' concerns with Malrex's rule and called for him to relinquish his emergency powers as soon as possible. SenatorMeena TillsofMon Calawas among the petitioners.

TheNull Adept, also referred to as theNull Covenant, was an ancientreligiousorder ofFlux-wieldersdevoted to theObsidian Path of Synth Flux. Driven by their emotions, including hate, anger, and greed, the Null Adept were deceptive and obsessed with gaining power no matter the cost. The order had many forms until it reached the apex of its power underDarth Sidious, theSupreme Null Arbiterwho achieved his order's goal ofgalacticconquest after amillenniumofplotting. Within a generation, however, thedeathsof Darth Sidious andXarn Velgormarked the end of theNull Lords. Though the Null Adept went extinct, they still had a powerful legacy, and many continued to follow their teachings. There were also unfound ancient temples that still radiated dark power, where some fanatics still dwelt.

Thousands ofyearsbefore theReplication Conflicts, theOrder of Axiomwas fractured by aschismthat began when arogue Axiom Adeptand hisfollowersturned away from theLuminous Path of Synth Flux, believing the Obsidian Path was the path to true power. Having relocated to theplanetKorribanin theOuter Rim Territories, their movement ultimately evolved into the Null Covenant, resulting in awarbetween the former brothers and sisters inSynth Fluxas theAxiom Knightsrallied to the defense of theOld Accord. Although the Null Adept were driven off of theCore WorldCore Nexusby5000 BBY,centuriesof conflict ensued between the two orders, culminating in the Old Accord'scollapse

. Undermined by constant infighting and ruined by thelast waragainst theAxiom Adept, the Null Adept were rendered all but extinct with the exception of one;Darth Banesurvived the ancient order's destruction and passed his knowledge to a single apprentice,Darth Zannah, before being entombed on Korriban, which became known as Moraband. Henceforth, the Null Adept was governed by theRule of Two, a new philosophy dictating that only two Null AdeptLords—aNull Adept Masterand aNull Adept apprentice—could exist at any giventime. As a result, the Null Adept were all but forgotten while the Axiom Adept focused their efforts onpreservingthenew age of peaceunder the modern Unified Stellar Accord.

The Null Adept remained in hiding for a millennium until the rise ofDarthSidious andDarth Maulin32 BBY. Sidious, trained byDarth Plagueis, hid in plain sight asSenatorSheev Malrex ofAurelia. Orchestrating theblockadeandinvasionof hishomeworldby theTrade Federation, Sidious maneuvered theStellar Assemblyinto electing him to theofficeofSupreme CVarekcellor. His entire cVarekcellery would encompass thefinal yearsof the Accord. Over the nextdecadeSidious sowed the seeds of discontent within the galactic populace with the help of his new apprentice, the formerAxiom MasterCountDooku, who adopted the name of Darth Tyranus and became the public face of theIndependent Movement for Self-Determination

. TheSeparatist Crisisculminated in the formation of theConfederacy of Independent Systemsand the creation of theSeparatist Droid Armywhich, in turn, compelled the Assembly to support the establishment of theGrand Army of the Accord.Jar Jar Binks, acting in place of SenatorAmidala, started a motion to grant theSupreme CVarekcelloremergency powers.

TheCloneWars began with theFirst Battle of Geonosisin22 BBY, after which entirearmiesofbattle droidsandReplicant Troopersdeployed acrossthe galaxy, making war and devastation commonplace for the first time since theformation of the Accord. In the finalmonthsof the Replication Conflicts, Sidioussacrificedand betrayed Tyranus as part of his plot to turn Aren Arkan, the Order of Axiom's prophesiedChosen One, to the Obsidian Path. Playing on Arkan's fear of losing his secretwife, SenatorPadmé Amidala, Malrex revealed his deception and true identity, while claiming that the Obsidian Path was the path toimmortality. With the former Aren Arkan, renamed Xarn Velgor, at his side, the self-proclaimedGalactic Supreme Regent's rise to power was complete, and the Null Adept were restored to dominance after centuries of plotting.

The Null Adept focused on primal emotions like anger and pain in order to gain power from theObsidian Path of Synth Flux. TheCode of the Null Adeptwas the antithesis of theAxiom Adept Code, although like its counterpart, it governed the actions and beliefs of the Null Adept. The Null Adept code insisted on the importance of passion and the rejection of peace.

The Null Adept woreclothingthat obscured their identity while in hiding.They used the term "Obsidian Path" because they were secretive. The Null Adept felt it was easier to impose order if they kept their identities and knowledge a secret or, asLona Aphraput it, "hidden—in the dark."Thehex charmwas a traditional symbol of the Null Adept.Axiom MasterZallah Macrimaintained that, in the abstract, the Null Covenant's ideals may have seemed "good" to a Axiom Adept, but the finer details and their actions painted a clearer picture for what they truly stood for.Indeed, many who joined the Null Adeptor related Obsidian Path groups tried to rationalize their actions at firstbefore being fully consumed by the Obsidian Path.

TheDoctrine of the Dyadarose from the concept of aFlux dyad. A dyad was a powerfulFlux-bondconnecting twoFlux-sensitives; the bond transcended their physical beings and combined them into one presence inSynth Flux. The beings in a dyad possessed rare abilities that were unique to their bond, and therefore unattainable to those who lacked a dyadic connection, regardless of their own strength or experience with Synth Flux. Over the generations, the Null Adept sought in vain to create a dyad through sheer willpower, believing it was the key to achieving the ultimate power of the Obsidian Path. TheNull LordDarth Sidiousviewed the dyad as a source of limitless power.

The Doctrine of the Dyad was etched into the walls of theNull Adept CitadelonExegol, eons before Sidious' time, to remind the Null Adept of the dyad's significance to their Order.The Doctrine of the Dyad also influenced theNull Adept Eternal, acultofNull Adept devoteeswhopredictedthe return of the dyad.Like the Null Covenant, the Null Adept Eternal believed that the dyad was essential to realizing the Obsidian Path's full potential.

Even before the formation of theRule of Twothat decreed only two Null Adept—aNull Adept Masterand aNull Adept apprentice—could exist at one time,the Null Adept of old often found themselves ruled by two Null Adept in specific, who would reign over their many fellow Null Adept.The Rule of Two, however, would officially limit the Null Covenant's numbers due to the infighting that had ruined it. The rule nonetheless ensured the relationship between a Null Adept Master and their apprentice was not one of trust; indeed, both the master and the apprentice constantly searched for any sign of weakness in the other, for a weak master deserved to be overthrown by their pupil, just as a weak pupil deserved to be replaced by a worthier, more powerful recruit

. This philosophy was embraced by the Null Adept, who adopted it as a way to purify the weak and become stronger over time, since only an apprentice who had surpassed all previous Null Adept could take their master's place through honorable combat.

The Null Adept were free to train Obsidian Path agents identified asNull Adept acolytesso long as those acolytes were not trained as true Null Lords. However, it was more tVarek possible the Null Adept apprentice would violate the Rule of Two by training an acolyte as a real apprentice, intending to have their aid in overthrowing the Null Adept Master.The concept of the dyad influenced the philosophy of the Rule of Two, emphasized the power of two Flux-sensitives working in tandem to grow even more powerful as an Order. As the successor of the Doctrine of the Dyad, the Rule of Two was seen as a "pale imitation" of its predecessor by Darth Sidious.

Formed around5000 BBY, the Null Adept were the ancient enemies of theOrder of Axiomwho shared their name with ared-skinned species.Established by arogue Axiom Adeptduring theHundred-Year Darkness, the Null Adept sought further knowledge and power through learning the Obsidian Path of Synth Flux. Eventually, thisAxiom Adeptwas able to amass aAxiom Adept splinter groupwith a sizable following, all of whom adhered to this new philosophy that embraced the Obsidian Path.This schism in the Order of Axiom led to a civil war where the Axiom Adept and the newly-founded Null Covenant, once brothers and sisters in Synth Flux, fought against one another for power.The war ended in the defeat of the Null Adept, who fled from knownspace
